rani_lakshmibai_of_jhansi.ref_desc: Rani Lakshmibai appears as a mid-20s athletic Maratha queen with a heart-shaped wheatish face, long braided black hair under a deep saffron nauvari sari, dark indigo choli, brown leather belts and boots, minimal gold jewellery, and a steel talwar in a brown scabbard.

chhatrapati_shivaji_maharaj.ref_desc: Shivaji Maharaj is a mid-30s compact warrior with wheatish skin, pointed black beard, white turban, white angarkha, off-white trousers, saffron sash, dark green sleeveless waistcoat, brown mojari shoes, and a steel talwar at his left hip with white, saffron, dark green, brown, and gold accents.

emperor_ashoka.ref_desc: Emperor Ashoka appears as a mid-30s broad-shouldered Mauryan ruler with an oval bearded face, black topknot and simple gold circlet, deep red tunic, off-white dhoti, pale saffron shawl, minimal gold jewellery, brown sandals, and a plain curved sword at his left hip.

rajendra_chola_i.ref_desc: Rajendra Chola I is a tall, medium-brown warrior-king with a high black topknot, gold forehead chain, deep-red angavastram, white veshti with gold border, gold ornaments, leather sandals, and a curved Chola steel sword in a dark brown scabbard, using red, white, gold, brown, and black tones.

tatya_tope.ref_desc: Tatya Tope is a lean mid-30s Maratha general with wheatish skin, sharp features, a prominent moustache, black hair under an off-white turban, wearing an off-white angarkha and dhoti with a maroon sash and beige shawl, carrying a brass-hilted talwar in a brown scabbard.

british_cavalry_officer_1858.ref_desc: A lean late-twenties British hussar officer with dark side-whiskers, short dark brown hair under a navy forage cap, wearing a dark blue gold-braided hussar tunic, blue breeches with gold stripe, black riding boots, and a brass-hilted sabre at his left hip.

sir_hugh_rose.ref_desc: Sir Hugh Rose is a stern blue-grey-eyed British general with receding grey hair under a dark navy peaked cap, wearing a dark navy frock coat with scarlet piping, khaki trousers, black boots, a brown sword belt, and carrying a brass-guard 1822 officer’s sword in a steel scabbard, with navy, scarlet, khaki, black, and brass tones.

mahipala_the_pala_king.ref_desc: Mahipala is a tall, broad-shouldered, early-40s Pala king with medium-brown skin, black hair in a high topknot held by a gold circlet, maroon silk tunic, gold-yellow over-tunic, off-white dhoti, green shawl, gold jewellery, sandals, and a curved sword in a brown scabbard with red-wrapped hilt.

aurangzeb_the_mughal_emperor.ref_desc: Aurangzeb Alamgir is a tall, lean, late-40s Mughal emperor with a narrow bearded face and stern dark eyes, wearing a white conical turban with green band, ivory patterned jama, maroon quilted waistcoat, emerald-green sash, dark churidar and mojari, and carrying a plain-hilted talwar in a brown scabbard with an ivory–green–maroon–gold–brown palette.

hiroji_farzand.ref_desc: Hiroji Farzand is a lean mid-20s Maratha with wheatish complexion, short moustache and small beard, saffron pagri over a low hair-knot, off-white angarkha, bottle-green quilted sleeveless waistcoat, cream churidar, brown mojari and a plain dark-brown-sheathed talwar on a red-and-gold sash.

mangal_pandey.ref_desc: Mangal Pandey is a lean mid-20s sepoy with an oval medium-brown face, dark intense eyes, black hair in a low bun with loose temples, wearing an off-white kurta under a red Bengal Infantry coatee, white churidar trousers, dark blue sash, brown boots, and carrying a long Brown Bess-style flintlock musket with fixed bayonet in a palette of deep red, off-white, dark blue, brown leather, and brass.

bahadur_shah_zafar.ref_desc: Elderly, thin Bahadur Shah Zafar with a long wrinkled face, white mustache and beard, wearing a deep green silk Mughal jama, cream churidar and shawl, brown mojari shoes, a tall crimson turban with a green jewel, and a plain leather-sheathed shamshir at his left side.

kunwar_singh.ref_desc: Elder Kunwar Singh has an oval weathered brown face with grey mustache and beard, long grey hair in a low knot under an off‑white turban, wearing an off‑white angarkha, olive quilted sleeveless coat, white churidar, dark maroon sash, brown mojari, right forearm bandage, and a curved talwar in a dark brown scabbard at his left side with off‑white, dark maroon, olive green, dark brown and beige colours.

bal_gangadhar_tilak.ref_desc: Bal Gangadhar Tilak is a medium-built late-middle-aged Maharashtrian man with a calm, intense face, black-grey mustache, deep-set eyes, wearing a red Puneri pagadi, off-white kurta and dhoti, dark indigo shawl, brown chappals, and carrying a brown leather notebook with pen.

lala_lajpat_rai.ref_desc: Lala Lajpat Rai is a medium-built, sixtyish man with a mustard-cream khadi turban, oval medium-brown face with a grey-black moustache, off-white kurta and churidar under a beige angarkha coat, a deep charcoal-brown shawl with maroon-striped border, brown leather shoes, and a rolled Tribune newspaper in his right hand.

bagha_jatin_jatindranath_mukherjee.ref_desc: Bagha Jatin is a tall, broad-shouldered man in his early 30s with medium-brown skin, short black hair combed back, a neat moustache, wearing an off-white khadi kurta, beige dhoti, simple sandals, a light gamchha, and carrying a dark-wood bolt-action rifle on a brown strap.

khudiram_bose.ref_desc: Khudiram Bose is a slim 17-year-old Bengali youth with short slightly wavy black hair, medium-brown skin, large determined dark eyes, wearing an off-white khadi kurta, cream Bengali-style dhoti with a thin maroon border, light-brown gamchha over his left shoulder, bare feet, and a brown leather cross-body satchel with a brass buckle and a wrapped paper packet protruding, in a palette of off-white, cream, light brown, maroon, and black.

rajaraja_chola_i.ref_desc: Rajaraja Chola I is a tall, muscular, medium-brown man with an oval face, arched brows, ash-and-red tilak, long black hair in a high topknot with a gold circlet and white tie, wearing a deep-maroon angavastra, cream veshti with maroon-gold border, simple gold ornaments, brown sandals, and carrying a plain curved steel sword with wooden hilt in a brown leather scabbard, with maroon, cream, gold, dark brown and black as dominant colours.

ainnurruvar_manigramam_merchant_guilds_a.figure: Ainnurruvar/Manigramam merchant guilds and Chola-era trade
ainnurruvar_manigramam_merchant_guilds_a.ref_desc: A lean Tamil merchant in his early 40s with an oval medium-brown face, short beard, low-knot black hair and simple off-white turban strip, wearing maroon angavastram, off-white tunic, cream veshti, dark indigo waist-sash, leather sandals, modest gold and bead jewellery, carrying a curved iron merchant’s scale and palm-leaf ledger in maroon, off-white, cream, dark indigo and dark brown tones.

chola_bronze_artisans_and_temple_patrons.figure: Chola bronze artisans and temple patrons
chola_bronze_artisans_and_temple_patrons.ref_desc: Manikkam of Thanjai is a lean late-20s Chola bronze artisan with warm medium-brown skin, oval face, center-parted black hair in a low bun under an ochre headband, wearing an off-white veshti with deep-maroon border, reddish-brown angavastram, minimal copper and bronze ornaments, and carrying a soot-darkened bronze pouring ladle and a small wax dancing-deity model in warm bronze tones.

chola_local_self_governance.ref_desc: A mid-20s medium-brown Tamil man with an oval face, small ash tilaka, black hair in a back kudumi, wearing an off-white ankle-length veshti with ochre border and cream angavastram with maroon stripe, bare feet, gold ear studs, and carrying palm-leaf manuscripts with an iron stylus.

karikala_chola.ref_desc: Karikala Chola is a mid-30s tall, lean Tamil king with a medium-brown complexion, scar on his right temple, high black warrior-knot with a gold band and jasmine string, bare chest with off-white angavastram, mustard-yellow silk vashti with maroon borders, copper and gold ornaments, dark-brown sandals, and a plain curved iron sword in a brown leather scabbard at his right hip in a mustard, maroon, off-white, dark brown and gold palette.

vijayalaya_chola.ref_desc: Vijayalaya Chola is a medium-brown, oval-faced Tamil king in his early 40s with a neat tapered moustache, high black kudumi topknot, narrow gold forehead band, wearing a dark maroon angavastram over off-white upper cloth, deep indigo gold-bordered veshti, simple gold jewellery, leather bracers and sandals, and carrying a plain curved iron sword in a dark brown leather scabbard, with a palette of maroon, indigo, off-white, gold, and dark brown.

kunjaramallan_the_temple_s_architect.ref_desc: Kunjaramallan is a lean, medium-brown, bearded Chola architect with a low black kudumi and white headband, wearing an off-white angavastram and veshti with brick-red border, copper and rudraksha bracelets, carrying a dark-brown teak architect’s staff with brass ends and palm-leaf plans.

kundavai_pirati.ref_desc: Kundavai Pirati is a late-20s Chola princess with a warm medium-brown oval face, large kohl-lined eyes, long black hair in a gold-ribboned braid under a narrow gold circlet, wearing a deep maroon silk sari with gold border, layered gold jewellery and kamarbandh, and carrying a rolled palm-leaf manuscript with a small bronze oil lamp, in a palette of deep maroon, gold, muted red, earthy brown and black.

kulottunga_chola_i.ref_desc: Kulottunga Chola I is a tall, medium-brown skinned emperor with an oval face, neat moustache, high black kudumi with a plain gold circlet, bare upper body with off-white angavastram, deep-red silk dhoti, gold waistbelt and armlets, brown sandals, and a curved steel sword in a dark-brown leather scabbard at his left hip accented by gold and deep-red tones.

kambar.ref_desc: Kambar is a medium-brown Tamil man in his late 30s with an oval face, black hair tied in a low knot with an off-white headband, wearing an off-white veshti with dark maroon border, cotton angavastram with gold stripe, simple beads and ash marks, and carrying a bound palm-leaf Ramayanam bundle with wooden stylus.

ashfaqulla_khan_and_ram_prasad_bismil.figure: Ashfaqulla Khan and Ram Prasad Bismil
ashfaqulla_khan_and_ram_prasad_bismil.ref_desc: Ashfaq is a lean mid‑20s man with an oval wheatish face, narrow moustache, short side‑parted black hair under a white Gandhi cap, in off‑white kurta‑pyjama with brown waistcoat and sandals, beside Bismil, a slightly broader fair‑wheatish man with a squarer face, straight moustache, short brushed‑back hair, in off‑white kurta‑pyjama, light‑grey waistcoat, off‑white angavastram and black shoes, and they share a worn brown leather shoulder satchel of papers in an off‑white, light‑brown, dark‑brown, light‑grey and black palette.

rani_abbakka_chowta.ref_desc: Rani Abbakka Chowta is a late-20s athletic woman with a medium-brown oval face, sharp dark eyes, black hair in a low bun under a deep-red headscarf, wearing a deep indigo kachche-draped sari with burnt-orange border, coconut-brown sleeveless war-vest, minimal brass-gold jewellery, bare feet with anklets, and carrying a simple brass-hilted tulwar with leather back-scabbard in a deep indigo, burnt orange, coconut brown, brass gold, and dark brown leather palette.

king_porus_puru.ref_desc: King Porus is a tall broad-shouldered warrior-king with medium-brown skin, long black hair in a low knot under a bronze conical helmet with crimson wrap, wearing an indigo quilted vest, bronze scale cuirass, off-white tunic and trousers, mustard-ochre cloak, crimson sash, and carrying a straight bronze-hilted sword in a brown scabbard.

bhagat_singh.ref_desc: Bhagat Singh is a lean early-twenties man with a light-brown oval face, thin mustache, short black hair under a tilted light-brown fedora, wearing an off-white kurta, dark-brown woolen coat, off-white trousers, dark-brown shoes, and carrying a brown notebook with a pen.

velu_nachiyar_and_kuyili.ref_desc: Velu Nachiyar is a warm-brown, sharp-eyed queen in a deep maroon madisar sari over a dark green blouse with an indigo quilted armour vest, jasmine-wrapped braid, minimal gold jewellery and a curved tulwar, beside Kuyili, a scarred, fierce warm-brown soldier in dull brown and off-white cotton wraps with a tight low bun, cloth-bound feet, and a rope-slung clay oil-pot and flint striker, all in maroon, indigo, dark green, earthy brown and cream tones.

chandragupta_i.ref_desc: Chandragupta I the First is a mid-30s athletic North Indian king with medium-brown skin, oval face, short beard, black hair in a low topknot under a narrow gold circlet, wearing an off-white diagonal uttariya, reddish-maroon patterned dhoti, simple gold jewellery, leather sandals, and carrying a slightly curved iron sword with a plain bronze hilt in a brown scabbard, accented by off-white, reddish-maroon, gold, and dark tones.

samudragupta.ref_desc: Samudragupta is a lean mid-30s Gupta king with warm medium-brown skin, an oval face with a small tilak, black hair in a low topknot under a plain gold circlet, wearing an off-white gold-bordered uttarīya, deep red gold-bordered dhoti, simple gold ornaments, brown sandals, and carrying a dark wooden recurve bow together with an unstrung dark-brown veena, in a palette of deep red, off-white, gold, warm brown skin and dark wood.

chandragupta_ii_vikramaditya.ref_desc: Chandragupta II Vikramaditya is a medium-built, early-30s Gupta emperor with an oval medium-brown face, short moustache, black hair in a low topknot under a narrow gold circlet, wearing a deep maroon sleeveless silk tunic, saffron sash, off-white bordered dhoti, gold ornaments, brown sandals, and holding a Gupta-style silver coin.

prabhavatigupta.ref_desc: Prabhāvatīgupta is a light-brown, oval-faced woman in her early thirties with large dark brown eyes, black hair in a high rounded bun with side-locks and a gold forehead ornament, wearing a deep maroon Gupta-Vakataka sari with muted gold choli and gold jewelry, holding a rectangular copper-plate grant bound with a sealed ring, in a palette of deep maroon, muted gold, warm brown, black and soft red.

faxian_the_pilgrim.ref_desc: Faxian is a mid-40s lean Chinese monk with a tanned oval face, shaved stubble hair and white headband, wearing a cream inner robe, saffron-ochre patchwork kāṣāya, dark grey-blue trousers, brown travel boots, scroll case and beads, carrying a bamboo staff with red-tied bells.

aryabhata.ref_desc: Young lean Āryabhaṭa with medium‑brown oval face, compact black topknot, red sandal tilak, off‑white uttarīya over a cream dhoti with deep‑indigo hem stripe, wooden mala, copper armlet, leather sandals, and a tied palm‑leaf Aryabhatiya manuscript with dark‑wood gnomon, in off‑white, maroon and indigo tones.

brahmagupta.ref_desc: Brahmagupta is a lean, medium-brown man of about 35 with an oval high-foreheaded face, neat moustache, dark hair tied in a low knot under a cream uttariya hood, wearing an off-white dhoti with deep-red border and subtle-checked shawl, carrying a birch-bark manuscript bundle with dot numerals and a reed stylus, in off-white, deep red, indigo, pale ochre and dark brown tones.

the_master_smith_of_the_iron_pillar.display_name: The Master Smith of the Iron Pillar
the_master_smith_of_the_iron_pillar.figure: The Master Smith of the Iron Pillar
the_master_smith_of_the_iron_pillar.ref_desc: A lean Gupta-era ironsmith in an off-white dhoti with dark-red sash, bare torso under a soot-stained dark-brown leather apron, black hair in a short topknot with a brown headband, iron-grey sledgehammer in hand, brown sandals, and accents of indigo cloth.

sushruta_the_surgeon.ref_desc: Sushruta is a lean, mid-30s Kashi surgeon with medium-brown skin, an oval face, short beard, black hair in a small topknot with a white forehead band, wearing an off-white angarkha, off-white dhoti, pale-ochre shawl, leather sandals, copper bangle, carrying a curved iron surgical knife in a back-waist sheath and a palm-leaf manuscript, in off-white, pale ochre, dark brown and leather-brown tones.

kumaragupta_i.ref_desc: Kumaragupta the First is a tall, athletic, medium-brown man with an oval face, red tilak, black hair in a high topknot under a simple gold circlet, wearing a white angarakha, deep-red dhoti, mustard-yellow shawl, modest gold jewellery, brown belt, and carrying a sheathed straight iron sword at his left hip while holding a rolled palm-leaf manuscript, all in white, deep red, mustard yellow, dull gold, and brown leather tones.

kalidasa.ref_desc: Kālidāsa is a lean, medium-brown man of about 30 with an oval face, calm dark eyes, black hair in a low knot with a cream headband, wearing an off-white shawl over a saffron dhoti and brown sandals, carrying an indigo-wrapped palm-leaf manuscript tied with a red cord.

the_master_sculptor_of_the_gupta_age.display_name: The Master Sculptor of the Gupta Age
the_master_sculptor_of_the_gupta_age.figure: The Master Sculptor of the Gupta Age
the_master_sculptor_of_the_gupta_age.ref_desc: A lean, medium-brown Gupta-age sculptor with an oval face, topknot and white headband, wearing an off-white angavastra over a white dhoti with a reddish-brown border, small gold hoops, copper bangle, brown sandals, and carrying a dark-handled iron hammer with a chisel at his belt in warm off-white and brown tones.

skandagupta.ref_desc: Skandagupta is a medium-brown, strong-jawed North Indian man in his early 30s with a high black topknot and gold fillet, wearing a deep red angarkha, indigo waistcoat, white-gold dhoti, cream uttariya, minimal gold jewellery, and carrying a long curved iron sword in a brown leather scabbard.

chandragupta_maurya.ref_desc: Chandragupta Maurya is a tall, athletic late-20s man with medium-brown skin, strong jaw, scar over his right eyebrow, long black hair in a low warrior’s knot with a plain gold headband, wearing a deep indigo sleeveless vest, off-white dhoti with dark-red sash, minimal dull-gold jewellery, brown bracers and sandals, and carrying a simple iron straight sword at his left hip with a brown leather scabbard and deep-maroon shawl pushed back.

kautilya_chanakya.ref_desc: Kautilya is a mid-40s lean, medium-brown man with an oval face, intense narrow eyes, a long braided shikha, off-white dhoti, saffron-ochre uttariya, sacred thread, simple sandals, a copper bangle, and a rolled palm-leaf Arthashastra manuscript bundle bound with dark cord.

megasthenes.ref_desc: Megasthenes is a mid-30s lean Greek man with tanned oval face, short wavy dark hair, trimmed beard, wearing an off-white knee-length chiton, indigo himation, leather sandals, indigo kausia at his belt, and a brown-strapped wooden papyrus scroll case, in off-white, indigo, tan and dark brown tones.

bindusara.ref_desc: Bindusara Amitraghata is a tall, solidly built late-30s Mauryan king with an oval medium-brown face, small bindu birthmark at his right temple, black hair in a high topknot with a gold headband, wearing a white angarakha over deep indigo dhoti, saffron-ochre uttariya, minimal gold jewellery, brown sandals, and carrying a lotus-tipped dark-wood iron-staff, in a white, deep indigo, saffron-ochre, maroon, and dull-gold palette.

ashoka.ref_desc: Ashoka is a tall, broad-shouldered, medium-brown man in his late 30s with an oval face, short black hair brushed back, neat beard, a plain gold circlet, wearing an ivory uttariya over a deep maroon antariya with golden-yellow borders, minimal gold jewellery, brown sandals, and carrying a palm-leaf manuscript bundle with stylus and a slender carved wooden staff in a palette of ivory, deep maroon, golden yellow, light ochre, and dark brown.

james_prinsep.ref_desc: James Prinsep is a slim late-20s man with a fair sunburned oval face, chestnut side-parted hair with mutton-chop sideburns, wearing a cream waistcoat, white rolled-sleeve shirt, dusty-blue tailcoat, dark-brown trousers, a loose dark-green cravat, and holding a twine-bound leather notebook with Brahmi notes and a palm-leaf manuscript, in a cream, white, dusty blue, dark brown, and dark green palette.

mahinda_and_sanghamitra.ref_desc: Mahinda is a lean, medium-brown, shaven-headed monk in saffron-ochre Mauryan robes with a palm-leaf manuscript bundle, and Sanghamitta is a serene, medium-brown nun in pale yellow and saffron robes with a white headwrap carrying an earthen pot holding a green Bodhi sapling.

ashoka_and_dasharatha_maurya.ref_desc: Ashoka and Dasharatha appear together: square-jawed scarred Ashoka with close-cropped hair, gold diadem, indigo tunic, cream dhoti and lion-capped staff beside earnest Dasharatha with low bun, bronze band, brick-red tunic, off-white dhoti and palm-leaf document bundle in indigo, saffron, cream and brown tones.

brihadratha_maurya_and_pushyamitra_shung.ref_desc: Brihadratha and Pushyamitra stand together, Brihadratha in deep indigo antariya and cream uttariya with gold circlet and manuscript bundle, Pushyamitra in earthy red-brown antariya, dark olive tunic, red cloth hair band and iron sword at his hip.

the_didarganj_yakshi.ref_desc: Didarganj Yakshi appears as a serene medium-brown oval-faced woman with a central forelock curl and low bun, robed in cream-beige draped garments with gold jewellery and earthy red sash, holding a long chauri with off-white plume in a warm sandstone-beige, gold and dark brown palette.

harihara_i_and_bukka_raya_i.figure: Harihara I and Bukka Raya I
harihara_i_and_bukka_raya_i.ref_desc: Harihara I has an oval medium-brown face with a neat moustache, short-knotted black hair and gold headband, cream tunic, maroon dhoti, dark green quilted vest, saffron-ochre shawl, simple gold jewelry, and a sheathed steel sword with brown scabbard and brass fittings.

the_city_of_hampi.ref_desc: Hampi’s spirit appears as a medium-brown, oval-faced young guardian with a high black braid and gold-edged turban band, in off-white angavastra, maroon blouse, mustard-ochre dhoti, blue waist-sash and bronze bangles, carrying a palm-leaf city map and wooden measuring staff.

kamalapura_tank_and_the_bukka_aqueduct.figure: Kamalapura Tank and the Bukka Aqueduct
kamalapura_tank_and_the_bukka_aqueduct.ref_desc: A lean, medium-brown Vijayanagara water engineer with an indigo angarakha over a cream dhoti, black hair in a short knot and headband, copper bangles, leather sandals, and a wooden measuring staff plus palm-leaf plans at his belt in indigo, cream and brown tones.

krishnadevaraya.ref_desc: Krishnadevaraya appears as a late-30s, medium-brown, broad-shouldered South Indian king with a maroon gold-crowned turban, maroon silk jamā, olive war-vest, indigo churidar, cream sash, gold belt and jewelry, wielding a ruby-hilted talwar in a brown scabbard with a deep maroon, olive, indigo, cream and gold palette.

vittala_temple_craftsmen.ref_desc: A mid-30s Vittala Temple craftsman with medium-brown oval face, black topknot and off-white headband, wearing a sandalwood beige angarkha, off-white panchakachcha dhoti, reddish-brown waist sash, simple sandals, and carrying a steel chisel with stone hammer in muted earthy tones.

paes_nunes_abdur_razzaq_and_nicolo_de_co.figure: Paes, Nunes, Abdur Razzaq and Nicolo de' Conti
paes_nunes_abdur_razzaq_and_nicolo_de_co.ref_desc: A mid-30s lean bearded traveller with shoulder-length dark brown hair and headband, wearing an indigo jama-coat over cream tunic, sand-brown trousers, russet-red shoulder shawl and dark leather boots, carrying a strapped leather notebook and reed pen in a warm indigo-brown palette.

vijayanagara_merchants.ref_desc: A mid-30s Vijayanagara merchant with medium-brown oval face, black tied-back hair under an off-white headcloth, off-white tunic, indigo dhoti with marigold and brick-red border, brown leather vest and sandals, carrying a dark teakwood chest of gold varaha coins and a palm-leaf ledger.

amara_nayakas.ref_desc: An athletic early-30s South Indian amara-nayaka with medium brown skin, black hair in a knot under a deep-red gold-trimmed turban, indigo quilted war-jacket, cream tunic, brown trousers, dark leather boots and belts, bearing a curved talwar and palm-leaf records in crimson and earthy tones.

aliya_rama_raya.ref_desc: Aliya Rama Raya is a tall, broad-shouldered, late-middle-aged South Indian man with a medium-brown complexion, grey-streaked shoulder-length hair tied back, maroon turban, deep-red angarakha, cream trousers, green waist sash, off-white gold-bordered anga-vastram, simple regal jewellery, steel breastplate, and a curved steel sword with red scabbard at his left hip.

purandara_dasa.ref_desc: Purandara Dasa is a lean, medium-brown, middle-aged Haridasa with short grey-streaked hair in a small knot, Madhva tilaka, off-white kurta, white dhoti, saffron and maroon cotton drapes, tulasi malas, paduka sandals, and a tall tan-brown jackwood tambura.

tenali_ramakrishna.ref_desc: Tenali Ramakrishna is a lean mid-30s Telugu poet with medium-brown skin, oiled black hair in a small bun, Vaishnava tilak, off-white angavastram, cream dhoti with mustard border, simple beads, brown sandals, and a palm-leaf manuscript bundle with reed stylus in maroon and mustard tones.

hampi_and_the_aravidu_heirs.ref_desc: Tirumala Deva Raya is a tall, medium-brown man with an oval face, pointed beard, high knot under a crimson kulah cap, wearing a deep-green silk angarkha, maroon quilted coat, saffron sash, white paijama, stone-grey shawl, and bearing a brass-inlaid talwar with rolled map.

mehrgarh_farmers.ref_desc: Mehrgarh Farmer-Healer is a lean, sun-browned young adult with dark almond eyes, low ponytailed dark hair and cloth headband, wearing an off-white tunic, ochre shawl, earth-brown wrap skirt, bead necklace, sandals, and carrying a tall reddish-brown digging stick with a small pouch.

harappan_city_builders.ref_desc: Harappan City Builder with medium-brown oval face, low black hair knot with copper headband, off-white waistcloth, taupe draped upper cloth, light-ochre sleeveless vest, brown sandals, simple copper and bead jewellery, and a rectangular wooden measuring rod with cord in warm neutral colours.

harappan_civic_councils.ref_desc: A mature Harappan civic councillor with an oval medium-brown face, short black hair in a neat back knot and slim headband, brick-red checked shawl over ivory dhoti, modest stone and bronze jewellery, dark sandals, and a dark-grey unicorn seal with small bronze balance at his waist.

mohenjo_daro_engineers.ref_desc: A mid-20s Mohenjo-daro engineer with medium-brown skin, black hair in a low knot with a copper head-ring, off-white tunic, brick-red shoulder shawl, brown wrapped skirt, leather sandals, simple bead and copper jewelry, carrying a wooden L-shaped measuring staff and a clay plan tablet.

harappan_sanitation_workers.ref_desc: A lean mid-20s Harappan sanitation worker with medium-brown skin, black topknot and cloth headband, wearing beige dhoti, clay-ochre tunic, indigo-striped shawl, leather sandals, minimal copper and steatite jewellery, carrying a wooden drain-rod with bronze scraping blade in a beige, clay and indigo palette.

dholavira_water_engineers.ref_desc: A lean, mid-30s Dholavira water engineer with tanned medium-brown skin, dark hair in a low knot with an off-white headband, wearing an indigo sleeveless tunic over off-white garments and dhoti with simple sandals, carrying a clay tablet planner in muted earth tones.

harappan_bead_makers.ref_desc: A mid-20s Harappan bead maker with oval medium-brown face, black hair in a low bun, off-white tunic, terracotta dhoti, carnelian necklace, bronze wrist bangle, and leather sandals, holding a stone drill-board and bow-mounted chert micro-drill in deep carnelian-orange, brown, and off-white tones.

harappan_weighmasters.ref_desc: Harappan Weighmaster with oval medium-brown face, trimmed short beard, tied-back black hair and linen headband, wearing terracotta tunic, off-white dhoti, cream shawl with indigo border, leather sandals, shell necklace, copper bangle, and holding a stone balance scale with chert weights.

harappan_sea_traders.ref_desc: Harappan Sea Trader of Lothal is a lean, mid-20s Meluhhan sailor with medium-brown skin, black topknot, off-white kilt, pale tan mantle, indigo sash, brown sandals, carnelian bead and hanging seal on a cord, and copper bangle in a muted natural palette.

harappan_seal_cutters.ref_desc: A lean mid-20s Harappan seal cutter with medium-brown skin, low black hair bun and cord headband, in an off-white tunic, brown dhoti with dark indigo border, dusty-terracotta shawl and simple beads, holding a small square unicorn steatite seal with copper chisel and burnisher.

indus_script_scholars.ref_desc: A focused early-30s Indus script scholar with light-brown skin, short wavy black hair, glasses, a cream cotton kurta, dark-navy chinos, brown leather shoes, maroon stole, and a brown canvas messenger bag full of replica Indus seals and a laptop.

harappan_artists.ref_desc: Harappan Artist of Mohenjo-daro is a mid-20s lean craftsperson with medium-brown complexion, dark hair in a low bun and cord headband, wearing off-white wrap, terracotta shawl, indigo skirt, copper bangles, and holding a clay tray of miniatures with a bronze stylus.

rakhigarhi_woman_and_late_harappans.ref_desc: Rakhigarhi Woman is a lean, medium-brown Late Harappan villager with a calm oval face, long center-parted black hair in a single braid, wearing an indigo wrapped lower cloth, buff-beige tunic, off-white shawl, modest Harappan jewelry, and a patinated copper sickle at her hip with terracotta-red accents.

babur.ref_desc: Babur is a lean, early-40s Central Asian commander with an oval, bearded face, dark brown hair in a low knot under a tall green-gold turban, wearing a dark teal striped chapan, maroon outer coat, cream under-tunic, indigo trousers, brown boots, saffron shawl, and carrying a curved sabre in a brown leather scabbard.

gulbadan_begum.ref_desc: Gulbadan Begum is a mid-50s Mughal princess with warm-brown oval face, dark greying hair under an off-white gold-edged dupatta, wearing a cream floral jama, sea-green paijama, pale-rose sleeveless waistcoat, simple gold jewellery, and holding a leather-bound manuscript with a reed pen.

akbar.ref_desc: Akbar appears as a late-20s Mughal emperor with an oval light-brown face, neat moustache and goatee, dark eyes, a cream turban with gold-edge and single feather, wearing a deep red patterned silk jama, cream churidar, emerald-green patka, tan mojari shoes, modest gold jewellery, and carrying a gold-hilted talwar in a brown leather scabbard at his left hip.

akbar_and_man_singh.ref_desc: Akbar has an oval face, maroon Mughal jama with emerald sash, cream turban and scroll, while Man Singh has a squarer jaw, saffron Rajput turban, indigo angarkha over mail armour, red sash and a sheathed talwar, all in maroon, indigo, emerald, saffron and cream tones.

raja_todar_mal.ref_desc: Raja Todar Mal is a late‑middle‑aged, wheatish‑complexioned man with an oval face, short hair under a maroon turban with a white feather, off‑white angarkha, dark indigo quilted waistcoat, saffron patka, beige churidar, brown mojari shoes, and a bamboo jarib measuring rod with a tucked ledger.

mir_sayyid_ali_and_abdus_samad.figure: Mir Sayyid Ali and Abdus Samad
mir_sayyid_ali_and_abdus_samad.ref_desc: Two late-30s Mughal Persian master painters stand together, both in small white caps with cream turbans, one in a sky-blue striped jama with maroon sash and grey stole, the other in an ivory floral jama with teal sash and yellow stole, slim off-white churidar, tan mojari shoes, calmly holding a large partly unrolled Hamzanama cotton folio on a wooden frame while one carries a reed pen and the other a fine brush, using a sky blue, ivory, maroon, mustard and dark teal palette.

jahangir_and_ustad_mansur.ref_desc: Jahangir is a slim Mughal emperor with light brown oval face, short pointed beard, pale gold turban with jade-green feather, saffron-gold floral silk jama, white churidar, emerald patka and brown mojari holding a golden huqqa mouthpiece beside Ustad Mansur, a focused medium-brown painter with cream turban, light blue-grey striped jama, rust-brown patka, brown mojari and a dark indigo folio showing a bird painting corner, all in saffron gold, emerald green, cream, light blue-grey and rust brown tones.

nur_jahan.ref_desc: Nur Jahan is a mid-30s Mughal empress with an oval wheat-gold face, large brown eyes, black hair in a low bun under an off-white gold-edged dupatta, wearing a pastel rose silk jama, off-white churidar, tan mojari shoes, pearl-and-emerald jewellery and holding a silver-gold framed Mughal coin.

shah_jahan_and_mumtaz_mahal.ref_desc: Shah Jahan is a light-brown, oval-faced Mughal emperor in a cream, gold-floral jama with maroon sash, pale-green shawl and white turban with green plume holding a pale-blue Taj Mahal plan scroll beside Mumtaz Mahal, a light-brown, heart-faced woman in pastel-peach angarkha, cream dupatta and pearl jewellery sharing the same scroll, all in cream, pale gold, pastel peach, pale green and maroon tones.

dara_shukoh.ref_desc: Dara Shukoh is a tall, slim Mughal prince in a light-cream striped jama, white churidar, forest-green waist sash, pale-blue shawl, cream turban with a small gold-red ornament, carrying a reddish-brown Persian manuscript and a plain-hilted dagger at his sash.

dara_shukoh_and_aurangzeb.ref_desc: Depict Dara Shukoh and Aurangzeb as mid-30s Mughal princes with oval bearded faces, neat turbans, Dara in off-white and pale-green jama with light-cream quilted coat and talwar, Aurangzeb in light-cream striped jama with dusky-olive coat and maroon sash, both in brown leather boots.

virji_vora_and_the_surat_merchants.figure: Virji Vora and the Surat merchants
virji_vora_and_the_surat_merchants.ref_desc: Virji Vora is a late‑middle‑aged, medium‑brown, sharp‑eyed merchant with a neat salt‑and‑pepper beard, short hair under a white turban with pale‑gold border, wearing an off‑white angarkha, saffron under‑tunic, deep maroon waistcoat, white churidar, dark‑green shawl, brown mojari shoes, and carrying a dark‑wood writing board with reed pen and bead‑counters.

aurangzeb_alamgir.ref_desc: Aurangzeb Alamgir is a lean, late‑aged Mughal emperor with a narrow bearded face, tall off‑white turban, cream‑striped jama, deep bottle‑green embroidered sleeveless coat, maroon sash, beige churidar, brown mojari shoes, and a plain‑hilted curved talwar in a brown scabbard.

pulakeshin_i.ref_desc: Pulakeshin I is a medium-brown Deccan man in his late-30s with an oval face, small moustache, scarred left cheek, and black hair in a high knot, wearing a reddish-brown long tunic, cream trousers, deep-ochre angavastra, bronze chest guard and arm-guards, modest gold jewellery, and carrying a curved iron sword at his left hip with a dark shield.

mangalesa.ref_desc: Mangalesa is a sturdy, dark‑complexioned early Deccan king with a topknot under a gold circlet, wearing an off‑white angavastra over a saffron‑ochre tunic, deep‑red kamarband and off‑white dhoti, gold jewelry, and a curved sword in a brown leather scabbard, dominated by off‑white, deep red, saffron‑ochre, gold and dark brown tones.

pulakeshin_ii.ref_desc: Pulakeshin II is a late-30s Deccan king with a brown complexion, black hair in a high topknot under a gold circlet, wearing an off-white tunic, coppery harness, deep indigo dhoti, mustard-gold shawl, brick-red sash, and carrying a curved sword at his left hip.

vikramaditya_ii.ref_desc: Vikramaditya II is a late-30s, medium-brown Deccan king with an oval face, trimmed moustache and beard, black hair in a high topknot with a gold circlet, wearing an off-white wrapped tunic, deep red dhoti, bronze corselet, gold jewellery, crimson sash, and carrying a long straight-edged steel sword in a dark brown scabbard.

dantidurga.ref_desc: Dantidurga is a medium-built Deccan king with a neat moustache, black hair in a high knot wrapped by a gold band and maroon strip, wearing an off-white dhoti, dark indigo sleeveless vest, golden-yellow sash, restrained gold jewellery, and a slightly curving Deccan sword at his left hip.

early_chalukya_artisans.ref_desc: A lean early Chalukya Badami cave artisan with medium-brown skin, oval face, black hair in a low knot with a white headband, wearing an off-white dhoti and beige upper cloth with brown belt and sandals, always carrying an iron hammer and chisel in earthy off-white and brown tones.

queen_lokamahadevi.ref_desc: Queen Lokamahadevi is a medium-brown oval-faced Deccan queen in a deep maroon silk sari with mustard-gold borders, olive blouse, modest red-edged veil, gold jewellery, a waist-belt, sandals, a sheathed short sword at her belt, and a bound palm-leaf manuscript in hand.

krishna_i_rashtrakuta.ref_desc: Krishna I appears as a medium-brown, sharp-eyed Deccan warrior-king in his late 30s with wavy black hair in a low topknot and simple gold headband, wearing a maroon angarkha over an off‑white gold-bordered dhoti, mustard-gold shawl, brown belt and sandals, modest gold jewelry, and holding a rolled architectural scroll and a straight iron measuring rod.

vikramaditya_i_and_chalukya_scribes.ref_desc: Vikramaditya I is a medium-brown, sharp-eyed Chalukya king with a black topknot and moustache, wearing an off-white dhoti, light-cream tunic, deep-red silk shawl, gold jewellery and sandals, holding a copper-plate grant bundle with a small seal and stylus.

govinda_iii.ref_desc: Govinda III is a medium-brown, early-30s Deccan king with an oval face, short moustache, black hair in a low knot under a simple gold coronet, wearing a deep indigo tunic, maroon quilted vest, off-white dhoti, saffron shawl, gold ornaments, and a plain-hilted steel sword at his left hip.

amoghavarsha_i_sulaiman_and_al_masudi.ref_desc: Amoghavarsha I has an oval medium-brown face with short beard, black topknot and gold circlet crown, wearing off-white tunic, deep-red silk sash, cream striped dhoti, gold jewellery and brown sandals, carrying a plain brown-scabbarded gently curving steel sword at his left hip.

amoghavarsha_i_and_sri_vijaya.ref_desc: Amoghavarsha I with Śrī Vijaya: oval-faced Deccan emperor and his scholar-poet, both medium-brown, with tied-back black hair, angavastra over tunic-and-dhoti outfits in off-white, gold and reddish-brown, modest Rashtrakuta-era jewelry, and palm-leaf Kavirajamarga manuscript plus stylus as shared signature props.

mahaviracharya.ref_desc: Mahāvīrācārya is a mid-40s Jain scholar with an oval medium-brown face, black hair in a low knot and white headband, wearing an off-white angarakha, cream dhoti, ochre uttarīya, copper bangles and sandals, holding a palm-leaf manuscript and wooden stylus in ochre-maroon tones.

qutb_ud_din_aibak.ref_desc: Qutb-ud-Din Aibak is a mid-40s, sturdy Turkic commander with a short beard, dark red quilted turban, deep teal qabā over mail-and-lamellar armour, cream tunic, beige trousers, brown boots and belt, carrying a deep red-sheathed curved saber in a steel-grey and earth-toned palette.

shams_ud_din_iltutmish.ref_desc: Mid-40s Iltutmish with a wheatish oval face, short black hair under a maroon turban-cap, deep indigo quilted Qaba over cream tunic, maroon surcoat, olive trousers, brown boots, and a sheathed curved cavalry sword at his left hip in indigo and bronze tones.

razia_sultan.ref_desc: Razia Sultan is a mid-20s athletic woman with an oval medium-brown face and calm determined gaze, black hair in a long braid under a red turban, wearing an indigo quilted jamā, maroon trousers, saffron chadar, brown boots and belt, carrying a brown-sheathed talwar.

ghiyas_ud_din_balban.ref_desc: Ghiyas-ud-Din Balban is a stern late-fifties Ilbari Turk with a long angular face, short dark hair under a crimson war cap, indigo quilted coat over royal blue tunic, cream trousers, crimson gold-edged surcoat, and a plain-hilt curved steel shamshir at his hip.

malik_kafur.ref_desc: Malik Kafur is a lean early-30s commander with an oval warm-brown face, medium black hair under a deep red war cap, chainmail and emerald-green quilted coat over off-white tunic and trousers, brown boots, indigo sash, and a curved Delhi cavalry sword at his left hip.

alauddin_khalji.ref_desc: Alauddin Khalji is a mid-40s, wheatish-complexioned Sultan with an oval bearded face, black hair under a conical steel helmet, wearing indigo quilted tunic, leather coat-of-plates, off-white trousers, dark green shawl, brown boots, and a curved steel sword at his left hip.

muhammad_bin_tughlaq.ref_desc: Muhammad bin Tughlaq is a tall, lean Sultan with wheatish skin, intense eyes, short beard, deep green quilted jama, cream trousers, maroon belt and overcoat, brown leather boots, green turban, and a simple brass-hilt talwar at his left hip.

timur.ref_desc: Timur appears as a late-50s, sharp-eyed Central Asian warlord with short grey hair under a deep red turban, royal blue gold-trimmed chapan over crimson robe, cream trousers, dark brown boots, and a brass-hilted curved saber at his left hip in a royal blue, crimson, cream, dark brown, and gold palette.

the_builders_of_mehrauli.ref_desc: A lean medium‑brown mason with short black hair under an off‑white turban, oval face with a cheek scar, in an indigo angarkha over off‑white kurta, light brown churidar, reddish‑brown sash and dark leather mojari, holding an iron mason’s hammer and wooden measuring rod.

firuz_shah_tughlaq.ref_desc: Firuz Shah Tughlaq is a late-middle-aged, wheatish-complexioned Sultan with deep-set intense eyes, short hair under a tall deep-green turban, rust-red quilted tunic, olive churidar, grey shawl, dark boots, and a sheathed dark-brown-belted talwar, in earthy reds, greens and browns.

amir_khusrau.ref_desc: Amir Khusrau is a mid-40s lean man with medium-brown complexion, short beard, rounded white embroidered cap, indigo jama over off-white tunic, sand-beige trousers, maroon sash, wooden bead mala, and he carries a rolled manuscript plus a pale brown long-necked tanpura-like instrument in an indigo–maroon–beige palette.

nizamuddin_auliya.ref_desc: Nizamuddin Auliya is an elderly, medium-brown skinned Sufi with a trimmed grey beard, white skullcap, off-white kurta, beige trousers, olive-green wool shawl with maroon border, brown sandals, and a looped dark wooden tasbih as his constant prop, in muted earthy colours.

the_greater_yuezhi.ref_desc: A young Greater Yuezhi yabghu with an oval, fair Central Asian face, shoulder‑length dark brown topknotted hair with red headband, deep red tunic, cream shirt, dark teal trousers, beige felt coat, indigo cloak, leather boots, and a recurved composite bow with hip quiver and dagger.

kujula_kadphises.ref_desc: Kujula Kadphises is a late-middle-aged, tan-complexioned warlord with a short beard, dark brown hair tied in a back knot with a red headband, wearing a deep red quilted riding coat, olive trousers, dark indigo cloak, dark brown boots, and carrying a plain cavalry sword and coin.

vima_kadphises.ref_desc: Vima Kadphises is a mid-40s broad-shouldered emperor with wheat-brown skin, black topknot hair and gold circlet, wearing a deep-red Kushan kaftan, saffron cloak, indigo trousers and brown boots, holding a Kushan gold coin with a simple sword at his hip.

kushan_merchants_and_administrators.ref_desc: A Kushan trade overseer with oval wheat-toned face, shoulder-length dark brown hair under a maroon cap, beige wrap tunic, dark indigo vest, rust sash, olive trousers, brown boots, bronze-carnelian jewellery, and a wooden inventory tablet with stylus in hand.

kanishka_i.ref_desc: Kanishka I is a tall, broad-shouldered Kushan emperor with an oval wheatish face, dark brown topknotted hair and gold circlet, in a deep red knee-length wrap coat with gold trim, off-white trousers, dark brown boots, saffron-yellow shawl, small gold jewellery, and a bronze-hilted sword in a dark brown scabbard at his left hip.

vasumitra_and_ashvaghosha.ref_desc: Vasumitra is a shaven Gandharan monk in saffron and deep maroon robes with a birchbark scroll, beside Ashvaghosha, a shoulder-length dark-haired bearded scholar in cream, grey-beige and indigo robes holding a wooden tablet and stylus, both wearing dark brown sandals.

gandhara_and_mathura_sculptors.ref_desc: A lean wheat-brown Kushan-era sculptor with an oval face, short knot of black hair and off-white headband, in off-white tunic, tan trousers, deep red sash, dusty teal shawl and dark brown sandals, holding a wooden mallet, iron chisel and red sandstone fragment.

ashvaghosha.ref_desc: Aśvaghoṣa is a mid‑40s, medium‑brown, bearded monk with short back‑combed black hair and indigo headband, wearing saffron‑ochre robes over off‑white tunic and brown trousers with reddish‑brown cloak and sandals, holding a red‑tied palm‑leaf manuscript bundle.

kushan_mint_masters.ref_desc: A mid-30s Kushan Mint Master with an oval olive-toned face, short black hair and trimmed beard, maroon rounded cap, off-white tunic, indigo sleeveless coat, sand-brown trousers, dark brown boots, and a Kushan silver coin with minting tools in a palette of off-white, indigo, maroon, sand-brown, dark brown, and dull gold.

huvishka.ref_desc: Huvishka is a broad-shouldered Kushan emperor with a short beard, dark brown tied-back hair under a deep red cap, wearing a saffron tunic, red sleeveless coat, cream trousers, brown boots, gold ornaments, and a curved sword in a dark-brown scabbard.

vasudeva_i.ref_desc: Vasudeva I is a late-40s Kushan ruler with a wheat-brown oval face, short beard, black topknot bound in red beneath a gold diadem, cream quilted tunic, maroon overcoat, brown trousers, gold ornaments, and a dark brown-sheathed straight sword accented in gold and deep red.

lokaraksha.ref_desc: Lokaraksha is a lean, mid‑30s Gandharan monk with cropped black hair and an indigo headband, wearing off‑white tunic and trousers under dusty saffron and brick red kāṣāya robes with a dark brown travel cloak, dark boots, and holding a rolled birchbark manuscript tied with red cord.

simhavishnu.ref_desc: Simhavishnu Pallava is a late-thirties South Indian ruler with an oval medium-brown face, black topknot and gold circlet, wearing an off-white dhoti, cream tunic, dark teal sash with maroon-gold borders, simple gold jewellery and brown sandals, carrying a curved sword in a brown scabbard.

mahendravarman_i.ref_desc: Mahendravarman I is a mid-30s, medium-brown Pallava king with wavy black hair in a high knot, gold circlet, white cloth and cream vest over a deep maroon dhoti, gold ornaments, carrying a palm-leaf manuscript and simple sword in white, maroon, pale gold and dark green tones.

narasimhavarman_i_mamalla.ref_desc: Narasimhavarman I Mamalla is a mid-30s, strong-built Pallava king with medium-brown skin, wavy black hair in a high topknot under a narrow gold circlet, wearing a reddish-brown angarkha, cream dhoti with maroon borders, bronze chest harness and bracers, gold torque and armlet, and a curved iron sword at his left hip in a brown scabbard, in a maroon, cream, reddish-brown, bronze and gold palette.

nandivarman_ii_pallavamalla.ref_desc: Nandivarman II Pallavamalla is a mid-20s, lean South Indian king with an oval medium-brown face, black topknot hair under a gold circlet, wearing cream long-sleeved royal tunic, maroon shawl, white dhoti with maroon-gold border, gold jewellery, and a sheathed curved sword at his left hip in cream, white, maroon, gold, and brown hues.

pallavas_and_chalukyas.ref_desc: Narasimhavarman I appears as a medium-brown, oval-faced young warrior-king with a high black topknot and gold band, off-white tunic, maroon dhoti, saffron angavastra, modest gold ornaments, and a curved South Indian sword in a brown scabbard with lion motif.

paranjothi_siruthondar.ref_desc: Paranjothi Siruthondar is a medium-brown, mustached Pallava commander with a vibhuti-marked forehead, black hair in a high kudumi and gold circlet, wearing maroon tunic, cream dhoti, bronze vest, mustard angavastra, leather gear, and carrying a sheathed sword plus a small draped stone Ganapati idol.

pallava_sculptors_of_mamallapuram.ref_desc: A mid-30s lean Pallava sculptor with warm brown skin, black hair in a short low bun under a white headband, wearing a pale tunic, sand-beige dhoti, dark brown shoulder cloth and sandals, carrying an iron hammer and stone chisel in a warm brown, beige and off-white palette.

narasimhavarman_ii_rajasimha.ref_desc: Narasimhavarman II Rajasimha is a lean, bearded Pallava king with a high black topknot and gold band, wearing cream angavastra, deep maroon dhoti with gold and green border, modest gold jewellery, brown sandals, and a plain curved sword at his left hip in a brown scabbard.

pallava_grantha_scribes.ref_desc: A mid-30s South Indian scribe with an oval medium-brown face, short beard, black hair in a low bun with white headband, wearing off-white dhoti, cream tunic, pale yellow angavastra with red borders, brown sandals, holding a palm-leaf manuscript and metal stylus.

pallava_grant_makers_and_village_council.ref_desc: A mid-30s South Indian Brahmin sabha member with an oval medium-brown face, oiled black hair in a back bun and white headband, off-white dhoti and upper cloth with maroon border, simple gold jewellery, ash-and-red forehead marks, holding bronze-brown copper plates and a palm-leaf stylus.

pallava_merchants_and_envoys.ref_desc: A mid-30s Pallava envoy with medium-brown skin, low-knotted black hair under a cream turban, off-white long-sleeved tunic, maroon angavastra, sand-brown dhoti, simple sandals, modest jewellery, and a reddish-brown palm-leaf letter tube, using maroon, off-white and sand-brown tones.

appar_and_mahendravarman_i.ref_desc: Appar is a lean older Tamil man with a low hair knot, off-white dhoti and light-ochre shawl carrying a wooden staff, while Mahendravarman is a younger Pallava king with a coronet, cream dhoti, gold tunic, maroon shawl and palm-leaf scroll, in off-white, ochre, cream, maroon and gold tones.

karaikkal_ammaiyar_and_andal.ref_desc: Karaikkal Ammaiyar is a late middle-aged, deep-brown-complexioned Shaiva poet with angular features, grey-black hair in a low bun under an off-white headcloth, wearing an off-white sari with madder-red border, rudraksha beads, ash-marked forehead, and holding a palm-leaf manuscript bundle in muted off-white and red tones.

haridatta_and_govinda_bhattathiri.ref_desc: Haridatta and Govinda Bhattathiri are two medium-brown Kerala scholars with black topknots, cream and sand-beige dhotis, off-white and ochre shawls, bead necklaces, barefoot, each holding a palm-leaf manuscript bundle with wooden stylus in maroon and dark green accents.

madhava_of_sangamagrama.ref_desc: Madhava of Sangamagrama is a lean, mid-40s Kerala scholar with a short beard, low-bun black hair and off-white headband, dressed in off-white upper cloth, cream dhoti with maroon border and shawl, holding a tied palm-leaf manuscript and wooden stylus in maroon-brown tones.

vatasseri_paramesvara.ref_desc: Vatasseri Parameśvara is a late-40s medium-brown Kerala scholar with an oval face, low-knot black hair and off-white headband, wearing cream dhoti with pale-gold border and off-white uttariya, copper wrist bangle, and carrying red-tied palm-leaf manuscripts with stylus and small wooden gnomon-sundial, in an off-white, cream, pale-gold, medium-brown and red palette.

nilakantha_somayaji.ref_desc: Nilakantha Somayaji is a lean middle‑aged Kerala brahmin with an oval medium‑brown face, black topknot and headband, cream‑white dhoti and angavastram with gold borders, wooden mala, sandals, and a palm‑leaf manuscript bundle with stylus in a cream‑gold‑brown palette.

madhava_s_mathematical_school.ref_desc: Jyeshthadeva is a medium-brown, sharp-eyed, short-bearded Kerala scholar in an off-white angarakha, cream dhoti with reddish-brown border, sandalwood-brown shawl, white headband, carrying a palm-leaf manuscript and stylus in a palette of off-white, cream, brown and black.

jyeshthadeva.ref_desc: Jyeṣṭhadeva is a lean late‑forties Kerala scholar with an oval medium‑brown face, shoulder‑length black hair in a low knot under an off‑white headcloth, wearing off‑white uttariyam and cream mundu with golden border, bronze bangles and tulasi mala, carrying a palm‑leaf manuscript bundle and stylus in off‑white, cream, golden yellow and brown tones.

sankara_variyar.ref_desc: Śaṅkara Variyar is a medium‑brown, slender Kerala scholar with black hair tied in a low knot and a sandal paste tilak, wearing a cream‑white kasavu‑border mundu and uttariya, carrying a palm‑leaf manuscript bundle and stylus in warm cream, gold, brown, and black tones.

kerala_scholar_households.display_name: Nila Valley Scholar of the Kerala School
kerala_scholar_households.ref_desc: A lean, mid-30s Nila valley scholar with an oval medium-brown face, oiled black hair in a back knot and white headband, wearing off-white dhoti and uttariya with golden-yellow border, simple beads and bangle, holding a red-tied palm-leaf manuscript in a warm off-white, gold, brown, black and soft red palette.

kerala_almanac_makers_and_port_kerala.display_name: Shankaran, Kerala Almanac Maker of Calicut
kerala_almanac_makers_and_port_kerala.figure: Kerala Almanac Makers and Port Kerala
kerala_almanac_makers_and_port_kerala.ref_desc: Shankaran is a medium-brown, moustached Malabar scholar with a short-knot black hairstyle and white headband, wearing cream-gold bordered dhoti, off-white upper cloth, light brown saffron-edged shawl and sandals, carrying a red-corded palm-leaf almanac bundle with wooden stylus, in cream, gold, brown, saffron and red tones.

acyuta_pisharati_and_melpathur_narayana_.figure: Acyuta Pisharati and Melpathur Narayana Bhattathiri
acyuta_pisharati_and_melpathur_narayana_.ref_desc: Acyuta and Melpathur are warm-brown Kerala scholars in white cotton mundu and angavastram with gold and maroon borders, compact low-bun black hair, sacred threads, bead malas, brown sandals, Acyuta holding palm-leaf manuscripts and stylus, Melpathur a red-tied palm-leaf scroll.

charles_matthew_whish.ref_desc: Charles Matthew Whish is a fair-complexioned English man in a dark navy tailcoat, cream shirt and light blue cravat, with short neat dark brown hair, holding a leather notebook and quill plus a rolled palm-leaf manuscript, in a beige-and-tan outfit with black shoes.

k_v_sarma_and_c_t_rajagopal.display_name: K. V. Sarma & C. T. Rajagopal
k_v_sarma_and_c_t_rajagopal.figure: K V Sarma and C T Rajagopal
k_v_sarma_and_c_t_rajagopal.ref_desc: K. V. Sarma and C. T. Rajagopal are lean, medium-brown, late-middle-aged scholars with short greying black hair, off-white shirts, beige dhotis, grey and pale blue shawls, carrying a worn dark-brown manuscript satchel and an open notebook in a muted off-white, beige, grey, blue palette.

kerala_transmission_debate.ref_desc: A mid-30s Kerala math historian with short wavy black hair, glasses, off-white shirt, navy Nehru waistcoat, sand mundu with maroon border, brown sandals, carrying a tan leather notebook and pencil in a palette of off-white, navy, sand, brown and maroon.

queen_nayanika.ref_desc: Queen Nayanika appears as a mid-30s Deccan queen with an oval medium-brown face, black hair in a high bun with gold headband, saffron-yellow red-bordered sari with gold jewellery, brown sandals, and a rolled palm-leaf manuscript in hand, using warm gold and deep red accents.

keezhadi_s_urban_families.ref_desc: Keezhadi Urban Mother has a warm brown oval face with a cheek mole, black hair in a low bun with gold pin and headband, a brick‑red sari with mustard border over an indigo blouse, bronze jewellery, and carries a pottery tray holding an iron sickle, terracotta die, and graffiti sherd, in brick‑red, mustard, indigo, warm brown, and bronze tones.

gautamiputra_satakarni.ref_desc: Gautamiputra Śātakarṇi is a medium-brown, oval-faced warrior king with a black topknot and gold circlet, wearing a maroon tunic, cream dhoti, saffron shawl, modest gold jewelry and brown sandals, carrying a plain long iron sword in a brown scabbard with maroon, cream, saffron, mustard and gold colors.

king_hala_and_the_sattasai_poets.figure: King Hala and the Sattasai Poets
king_hala_and_the_sattasai_poets.ref_desc: King Hala is a lean, medium-brown Deccan ruler with shoulder-length black hair in a low knot, gold forehead band, ivory dhoti with maroon border, pale gold tunic, saffron shawl, simple gold jewellery, brown sandals, and a palm-leaf manuscript bundle with stylus in saffron-gold-maroon tones.

the_chera_chola_and_pandya_houses.figure: The Chera, Chola and Pandya Houses
the_chera_chola_and_pandya_houses.ref_desc: Karikala Chola is a mid-30s medium-brown Tamil warrior with a high black topknot, indigo tunic, maroon veshti, ochre shoulder cloth, bronze ornaments, leather sandals, and a long recurved wooden bow with a back quiver in deep maroon, dark indigo and ochre tones.

yajna_sri_satakarni.ref_desc: Yajna Sri Śātakarṇi is a mid‑30s, medium‑brown Deccan king with an oval face, short beard, black hair in a low bun held by a golden crown‑band, wearing off‑white uttariya, maroon tunic, mustard dhoti, saffron sash, modest gold jewellery, and holding a copper ship‑coin, in off‑white, maroon, mustard, saffron and gold tones.

the_amaravati_donors_and_sculptors.ref_desc: An early-30s medium-brown Amaravati sculptor-donor with an oval face, short beard, black hair tied in a low knot and white headband, wearing off-white uttariya, beige under-tunic, white dhoti, bronze bangles, sandals, carrying a pale limestone relief panel with chisel and mallet in a reddish-brown sash palette.

bhutapala_and_the_karla_donors.ref_desc: Bhutapala is a sturdy, medium-brown, oval-faced merchant with a short beard, black hair in a low knot and cream headband, wearing an ivory tunic, saffron dhoti, indigo shoulder shawl, brown sandals, modest gold jewellery, and holding a rolled palm-leaf manuscript.

kodumanal_s_iron_workers.ref_desc: Kodumanal Ironworker is a lean late‑20s man with medium‑brown oval face, black hair in a low bun, indigo cotton upper cloth, beige dhoti, off‑white work shawl, copper bangles, leather sandals, holding iron crucible tongs and a clay crucible in indigo, beige and iron grey tones.

the_muzuris_pepper_merchants.ref_desc: A lean medium-brown Tamil pepper merchant with black hair in a low knot and white headband, wearing an off-white dhoti, beige tunic, indigo shawl with dark red border, simple gold and wooden ornaments, and carrying a pepper-filled trade basket with a leather coin pouch; colours off-white, indigo, dark red, brown, and gold.

satavahana_guild_donors.ref_desc: A medium-brown Deccan merchant in his early 30s with an oval face, small topknot and cream headband, wearing an off‑white draped upper cloth and deep-ochre bordered dhoti, gold studs and bangles, brown sandals, carrying a red-cloth-wrapped wooden ledger tablet and a coin pouch in a palette of off‑white, deep ochre, dark red, brown leather and gold.

tolkappiyar.ref_desc: Tolkappiyar is a mid-30s slim Tamil scholar with medium-brown skin, black hair in a low bun and a cream headband, wearing an off-white tunic, maroon-bordered veshti, ochre shawl, simple beads and bangle, carrying a rolled palm-leaf manuscript, in off-white, ochre, maroon, brown and black tones.

kapilar_and_vel_pari.ref_desc: Kapilar is a late-30s lean Tamil poet with medium-brown skin, wavy black hair in a low knot and maroon headband, wearing an off-white tunic, reddish-brown veshti, dull green shawl, simple jewellery, and carrying a palm-leaf manuscript bundle with wooden stylus in earth-toned colours.

maharani_tarabai_mohite.ref_desc: Maharani Tarabai Mohite is a medium-height Deccan woman with an oval face, calm steely brown eyes, black hair in a low braided bun with a red band, wearing a deep green nauvari sari with burnt-orange border, crimson choli, modest gold jewellery, maroon waist sash, light brown leather vest, Kolhapuri sandals, and a plain sheathed Maratha talwar at her left hip.

balaji_vishwanath_bhat.ref_desc: Balaji Vishwanath Bhat is a calm, wheatish-complexioned man in his early 50s with an oval face, neat moustache, maroon Deccani turban, white striped angarkha over beige churidar, dark indigo waist sash, dull-gold shawl, brown mojari shoes, and a rolled document bundle with writing board.

peshwa_bajirao_i.ref_desc: Peshwa Bajirao I is a late-20s lean cavalryman with medium brown complexion, sharp features and mustache, wearing a dark indigo pagadi, off-white angarkha under a dark red quilted coat, deep indigo churidar, saffron sash, brown mojari, and a brown-scabbarded tulwar at his left hip.

sarkhel_kanhoji_angre.ref_desc: Sarkhel Kanhoji Angre is a medium-brown, strong-jawed, moustached Maratha naval commander with a black topknot under a deep-red turban, wearing an off-white angarkha, dark-indigo quilted vest, blue churidar trousers, red sash, sea-green stole, and carrying a curved talwar at his left hip.

chimaji_appa.ref_desc: Chimaji Appa is a sturdy early-40s Maratha commander with a wheatish oval face, black tied-back hair under a deep-red turban, white angarkha over dark indigo dhoti, olive quilted war coat, saffron waist-sash, and a brass-hilted talwar with brown leather scabbard on a chest-crossing baldric.

sadashivrao_bhau.ref_desc: Sadashivrao Bhau is a tall, athletic Maratha commander with an oval wheatish face, short black beard and moustache, wearing a deep-red turban, off-white angarkha with dark-indigo sleeveless coat, red sash, brown mojari shoes and carrying a brass-hilted talwar in a brown scabbard.

peshwa_madhavrao_i.ref_desc: Peshwa Madhavrao I is a lean late-teen Maratha with an oval wheatish face and calm dark eyes, wearing a deep-maroon turban, white angarkha, cream paijama, buff leather waistcoat, maroon sash, brown mojari shoes, and carrying a brass-hilted shamsheer with a leather scabbard plus a rolled scroll.

hiroji_indulkar_and_maratha_engineers.ref_desc: Hiroji Indulkar is a wiry early-40s Maratha engineer with an oval medium-brown face, trimmed moustache and beard, saffron pagadi, white striped angarkha over indigo churidar, maroon waist sash, off-white shawl, leather sandals, and a wooden surveying staff with palm-leaf map case plus plain sheathed tulwar.

sant_tukaram_and_the_warkari_poets.figure: Sant Tukaram and the Warkari poets
sant_tukaram_and_the_warkari_poets.ref_desc: Sant Tukaram is a lean, medium-brown man in his late 30s–40s with an oval face, thin moustache, short black hair under an off-white turban, wearing a plain off-white kurta, ankle-length dhoti, pale-saffron shawl and wooden paduka, carrying a brown single-string ektara.

paithani_and_maheshwari_weavers.ref_desc: A medium-brown oval-faced young weaver with black hair in a low bun wrapped in an off-white headscarf, wearing a deep marigold-yellow Paithani-style sari with maroon zari peacock borders, bottle-green blouse, simple silver jewellery, always beside a wooden pit loom with a mixed Paithani–Maheshwari sari and holding its shuttle.

shahu_i_and_the_maratha_revenue_officers.display_name: Shahu I, Chhatrapati of the Marathas
shahu_i_and_the_maratha_revenue_officers.figure: Shahu I and the Maratha revenue officers
shahu_i_and_the_maratha_revenue_officers.ref_desc: Shahu I is a medium‑tall, warm-brown Maratha king with an oval face, black hair in a low knot under a saffron pheta, wearing an off‑white angarkha, deep red sleeveless jhabba, white dhoti, dark‑green waist sash, brown mojari shoes, simple gold jewellery, and carrying a rolled palm‑leaf revenue register with a sheathed talwar at his hip.

mahadji_scindia_and_benoit_de_boigne.figure: Mahadji Scindia and Benoit de Boigne
mahadji_scindia_and_benoit_de_boigne.ref_desc: Mahadji Scindia is a lean brown-skinned Maratha noble in a white angarkha, saffron turban and sash, modest gold jewellery and brown mojari shoes with a talwar at his hip, standing beside Benoit de Boigne in a navy European coat, beige trousers and black boots with a brass-hilted sword, both in white, saffron, navy, cream and brown tones.

nana_fadnavis.ref_desc: Nana Fadnavis is a late-40s Maratha statesman with an oval light-brown face, neat black moustache, deep maroon Puneri pagadi, off-white angarkha and churidar, pale-green shawl, dark-indigo kamarband, brown mojari shoes, and a rolled bundle of sealed papers with pen as his signature prop.

guru_nanak_and_bhai_mardana.ref_desc: Guru Nanak is a wheatish-brown, broad-faced, serene man in his early fifties with a mustard-gold turban, off-white kurta, mustard-gold sleeveless robe, warm grey shawl, off-white salwar, brown sandals and a dark wooden staff, standing beside lean Bhai Mardana in a white turban, pale blue-grey kurta and salwar with beige shawl and rabab, all in simple early 16th-century Punjabi traveller dress in mustard gold, off-white, warm grey, pale blue-grey and dark brown tones.

guru_angad.ref_desc: Guru Angad appears as a calm, middle-aged Sikh man with a wheatish oval face, white turban, neatly tapered beard, off-white kurta, light-cream churidar, light-ochre shawl, brown sandals, and carrying a simple brown pothi with a wooden writing board and reed pen in warm neutral tones.

guru_amar_das.ref_desc: Guru Amar Das is an elderly wheat-brown Punjabi man with an oval, lined yet gentle face, deep-set dark eyes, a long white beard and moustache, a simple off-white turban, a plain off-white kurta and churidar, a light-ochre chadar, brown juttis, and a smooth medium-brown wooden walking staff.

guru_ram_das.ref_desc: Guru Ram Das is a gentle, wheatish-complexioned man in his late-40s with a neatly rounded dark-brown beard, long hair wrapped in a plain white turban, wearing an off-white kurta, beige trousers, an ochre-golden shawl, dark-brown sandals, and carrying a rolled manuscript bundle with a reed pen.

guru_arjan_and_bhai_gurdas.ref_desc: Guru Arjan, in an off‑white jama with cream chadar, white dastar and brown jutti, gently steadies a large Adi Granth manuscript on a wooden stand beside Bhai Gurdas in light‑blue angarkha, deep indigo dastar and brown jutti holding a reed pen, ink pot and writing board.

guru_hargobind.ref_desc: Guru Hargobind is a mid-30s athletic Sikh man with a warm brown complexion, full black beard, navy turban with a steel chakar, deep navy jama over cream garments, saffron kamarband, steel breastplate, white churidar, and twin steel talwar swords for miri-piri at his waist.

guru_tegh_bahadur.ref_desc: Guru Tegh Bahadur is a mid‑50s, wheatish-brown, oval-faced Sikh with a serene expression, long hair under a tall white turban, wearing an off‑white kurta, light-cream salwar, pale-saffron chola, grey shawl, brown mojari shoes, a single steel kara, and carrying a plain curved talwar with a brown leather scabbard.

guru_gobind_singh_and_the_panj_pyare.display_name: Guru Gobind Singh & the Panj Pyare
guru_gobind_singh_and_the_panj_pyare.figure: Guru Gobind Singh and the Panj Pyare
guru_gobind_singh_and_the_panj_pyare.ref_desc: Guru Gobind Singh is a wheatish-complexioned, oval-faced man with a full black beard, royal-blue turban with gold sarpech and khanda, mustard-gold knee-length jama, white churidar, tan jutti, deep-blue sash, steel chakar, and a sheathed curved talwar at his waist, surrounded by similarly dressed blue-robed Panj Pyare.

banda_singh_bahadur.ref_desc: Banda Singh Bahadur is a lean, wheatish-complexioned Sikh warrior in a deep saffron angarkha, dark indigo quilted coat, white churidar, brown leather boots and belt, navy-blue turban with khanda emblem, carrying a curved steel talwar in a brown scabbard with steel kara on his wrist.

jassa_singh_ahluwalia_and_the_dal_khalsa.figure: Jassa Singh Ahluwalia and the Dal Khalsa
jassa_singh_ahluwalia_and_the_dal_khalsa.ref_desc: Jassa Singh Ahluwalia is a wheatish-complexioned, middle-aged Sikh leader with a navy-blue turban, neatly groomed greying beard, indigo angarkha, steel chestplate, saffron chadar, off-white choridar, brown boots, leather belt with coin-pouch, and a sheathed Sikh talwar in steel grey and brown tones.

maharaja_ranjit_singh.ref_desc: Maharaja Ranjit Singh is a wiry, medium-brown Sikh ruler with a clouded eye, cream turban with gold sarpech, mustard-gold angarkha, white churidar, deep-red sash, off-white shawl, tan jutti and a sheathed gold-hilt talwar at his left side.

ranjit_singh_allard_and_ventura.ref_desc: Ranjit Singh is a lean, middle-aged Sikh ruler with one clouded eye, a dark red turban, mustard-gold jama, off-white churidar, emerald green shawl, simple jewellery, dark brown jutti shoes, and a curved shamsher sword at his left hip in a dark scabbard.

mahendralal_sarkar.ref_desc: Mahendralal Sarkar is a late-30s Bengali man with an oval light-brown face, short parted black hair, moustache, round spectacles, wearing an off-white panjabi over a white dhoti with dark indigo shawl and brown shoes, holding a rolled red-tied deed document.

prafulla_chandra_ray.ref_desc: Prafulla Chandra Ray is a late-middle-aged Bengali chemist with oval spectacled face, short greying parted hair, white kurta and dhoti, charcoal-grey shawl, brown leather shoes, and a brown notebook with brass pen, in a white-grey-brown palette.

jagadish_chandra_bose.ref_desc: Jagadish Chandra Bose is a late-40s Bengali scientist with wavy charcoal-black hair, round spectacles, off-white kurta and pyjamas under a charcoal-grey frock coat, deep-indigo shawl, maroon cap, and a handheld brass-and-wood microwave horn and waveguide apparatus in brass-gold tones.

srinivasa_ramanujan.ref_desc: Srinivasa Ramanujan is a slender, medium-brown South Indian man with an oval face, short side-parted black hair, neat moustache, wearing a dark charcoal-grey suit with white shirt and navy tie, black Oxford shoes, and carrying a brown leather notebook with formulas.

c_v_raman_and_k_s_krishnan.ref_desc: Raman, in a dark charcoal-black suit, white shirt, navy-blue tie, and white turban, stands beside Krishnan, in a charcoal-grey suit, white shirt, maroon tie, both medium-brown, fully clothed, jointly handling a brass-and-black spectroscope with a glass sample tube against a subdued dark palette.

satyendra_nath_bose.ref_desc: Satyendra Nath Bose is a mid-40s, medium-brown, oval-faced man with short side-parted black hair, small steel spectacles, an off-white panjabi over cream pajamas, a soft brown shawl, dark brown shoes, and a dark brown leather briefcase with rolled papers.

subrahmanyan_chandrasekhar.ref_desc: Subrahmanyan Chandrasekhar is a slim late-20s man with medium-brown skin, short parted black hair, thin moustache, charcoal-grey suit, white shirt, navy striped tie, brown Oxfords, silver wristwatch, and a worn brown notebook of equations and galaxies.

meghnad_saha.ref_desc: Meghnad Saha is a mid-40s lean Bengali man with an oval face, short side-parted black hair, round metal spectacles, off-white kurta, charcoal-grey vest, off-white churidar, dark brown shoes, carrying a dark brown briefcase and rolled stellar-spectrum chart in an off-white, charcoal-grey, dark brown, soft beige and deep blue palette.

prasanta_chandra_mahalanobis.ref_desc: Mid-40s Prasanta Chandra Mahalanobis has an oval medium-brown face with round spectacles, short black hair, cream khadi Nehru jacket over white shirt, grey trousers, black shoes, and carries a rolled survey map plus brown clipboard in a cream-grey-black-navy palette.

janaki_ammal.ref_desc: Janaki Ammal appears as a slender early-40s woman with an oval medium-brown face, middle-parted bun hairstyle, white blouse and indigo cotton saree, simple silver accessories, dark brown leather field notebook and neck magnifier, in an indigo, white and brown palette.

homi_jehangir_bhabha.ref_desc: Homi Jehangir Bhabha is a mid-40s slim man with an oval Parsi face, short side-parted black hair, charcoal grey Nehru suit and trousers, black Oxfords, steel wristwatch, and a rolled blueprint tube, in a palette of charcoal grey, off-white, black and deep blue.

vikram_sarabhai.ref_desc: Vikram Sarabhai is a lean, early-40s man with an oval light-brown face, side-parted black hair, thin moustache, calm curious eyes, wearing a grey 1960s suit with white shirt and navy tie, holding a blueprint tube and a small white rocket model in a grey-white-navy-black palette.

shanti_swaroop_bhatnagar.ref_desc: Shanti Swaroop Bhatnagar is a early-50s, wheatish-complexioned man with round spectacles, short parted black hair under a cream Gandhi cap, in a charcoal-grey bandhgala over off-white kurta-churidar, black shoes, carrying a tan folder with lab blueprints and pen.

baudhayana_and_the_sulbasutra_cord_measu.figure: Baudhayana and the Sulbasutra cord measurers
baudhayana_and_the_sulbasutra_cord_measu.ref_desc: Baudhayana is a lean, late-40s Vedic geometer with medium-brown skin, shoulder-length dark brown hair in a low knot, off-white dhoti, saffron upper cloth, simple beads and copper bangle, holding a long measuring cord wrapped on a wooden peg in earthy browns.

panini_of_salatura.ref_desc: Pāṇini is a lean mid-30s Gandhāran scholar with an oval wheatish face, short beard, black topknot and off-white headband, wearing an off-white tunic and dhoti with an indigo mantle, leather belt and sandals, copper accents, holding a bound palm-leaf manuscript with stylus.

jivaka_komarabhacca.ref_desc: Jivaka Komarabhacca is a lean late-twenties North Indian man with an oval medium-brown face, small knot-tied dark hair and headband, wearing off-white wrapped robes with a light-ochre shoulder cloth and brown belt, dark leather sandals, and carrying a dark-wood medical box with palm-leaf scroll.

punarvasu_atreya_and_charaka.ref_desc: Atreya is a silver‑haired elder in off‑white dhoti, beige tunic and ochre shawl beside Charaka, a black‑haired scholar in cream dhoti, pale grey tunic and deep green shawl, both in brown sandals jointly holding a bound palm‑leaf manuscript in off‑white, ochre and green tones.

pingala.ref_desc: Pingala is a lean, medium-brown 35–40-year-old with shoulder-length black hair in a low knot, off-white dhoti, saffron shawl, simple sandals, palm-leaf manuscript bundle, and a wooden counting stick, colored in off-white, saffron, brown, and black tones.

kodumanal_wootz_ironworkers.ref_desc: A lean mid-30s South Indian ironworker with medium-brown skin, back-knotted black hair and indigo headband, wearing an off-white tunic, unbleached veshti, reddish-brown sash and dark brown sandals, carrying a soot-darkened sealed clay crucible with long iron tongs.

varahamihira_of_ujjain.ref_desc: Varāhamihira is a late‑middle‑aged brown‑skinned scholar with an oval bearded face, shoulder‑length dark hair in a low knot and white headband, wearing an off‑white dhoti and tunic with maroon borders and a saffron‑ochre shawl, always carrying a rolled palm‑leaf manuscript and wooden calculating board in a palette of off‑white, maroon, saffron ochre and earthy browns.

vagbhata_and_the_ashtangahridaya.ref_desc: Vāgbhaṭa appears as a lean late-40s scholar with oval medium-brown face, short beard, hair in a low bun and headband, in off-white dhoti, beige angarkha, maroon shawl and sandals, carrying a red-cord-tied palm-leaf Aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya manuscript with stylus, in warm maroon-beige tones.

takshashila.ref_desc: A lean early‑20s Gandharan student with an oval light brown face, black topknot and red headband, wearing a white tunic, brown trousers, indigo shawl with muted gold border and sandals, carrying a birch‑bark manuscript and short sword in a white, indigo, brown and gold palette.

bhaskara_ii.ref_desc: Bhaskara II appears as a lean late‑40s scholar with medium‑brown skin, shoulder‑length tied black hair, sandalwood tilaka, cream dhoti, light saffron long‑sleeved upper garment, white maroon‑bordered angavastra, simple gold studs, leather sandals, and carries a rolled palm‑leaf manuscript and wooden gnomon in cream, saffron, white, maroon tones.

al_biruni.ref_desc: Al-Biruni is a late-40s Persian scholar with an oval face, short beard, deep blue turban, cream robe, deep blue sleeveless overcoat, brown belt, grey shawl, dark brown boots, carrying a rolled Kitab al-Hind manuscript and a brass astrolabe in a cream, blue, brown, grey and brass palette.

the_bakhshali_manuscript.ref_desc: A mid-30s Gandharan scholar with medium-brown skin, dark hair in a low knot and off-white headband, wearing an off-white tunic, cinnamon-brown shawl, olive trousers and sandals, holding an aged birch-bark folio with dot zero and a reed stylus, in earthy tones.

sudangphaa_bamuni_konwar.ref_desc: Sudangphaa Bamuni Konwar is a mid-30s lean Ahom king with an oval medium-brown face, black hair in a topknot and gold forehead band, wearing a deep indigo jacket, golden-cream wrap, saffron-gold shawl and dark brown sandals, carrying a curved ceremonial sword at his left hip.

suhungmung_dihingia_raja.ref_desc: Suhungmung Dihingia Raja has an oval light-brown face with a moustache and short beard, black hair in an indigo-banded topknot, ivory cheleng tunic, mustard-gold patterned shawl, brick-red dhoti, subtle gold jewellery and a dark-brown-hilted curved sword on his back.

suhungmung_and_the_ahom_scribes.ref_desc: Suhungmung is a medium-brown Assamese warrior-king in his forties with a neat moustache and goatee, black hair in a topknot with a white headband, wearing an off‑white tunic, light‑indigo sleeveless coat, red sash, mustard dhoti, brown sandals, and carrying a curved sword in a brown scabbard and a rolled palm‑leaf manuscript with accents of red, off‑white, blue, mustard and brown.

momai_tamuli_borbarua.ref_desc: Momai Tamuli Borbarua is a lean, middle-aged Assamese man with an oval medium-brown face, neat black hair in a low knot under a pale-cream turban, wearing an off-white tunic, deep indigo dhoti, maroon sleeveless jacket, mustard sash, dark-brown sandals, small gold earrings, and carrying a rolled manuscript bundle and bamboo staff in a muted off-white, indigo, maroon, mustard and dark-brown palette.

ton_kham_borgohain_and_turbak_khan.figure: Ton Kham Borgohain and Turbak Khan
ton_kham_borgohain_and_turbak_khan.ref_desc: Ton Kham Borgohain is a lean, medium-brown Assamese commander with a black topknot wrapped in a white band, indigo tunic, red sash, leather lamellar armour, and a long matchlock musket, while Turbak Khan is a broader, bearded general in an olive quilted coat, steel helmet, simple breastplate, curved sword, and a small bronze cannon beside him, all in muted indigo, deep red, cream, olive green, and brown leather tones.

jayadhwaj_singha_and_chakradhwaj_singha.ref_desc: Jayadhwaj Singha and Chakradhwaj Singha are medium-brown Assamese brothers with oval faces, black topknots, Jayadhwaj in deep-indigo tunic and cream dhoti, Chakradhwaj in maroon-brown padded tunic and ochre dhoti, both with white-and-red gamosa cloths and a single shared long Assamese dao in a dark-brown scabbard.

lachit_borphukan.ref_desc: Lachit Borphukan is a mid-30s Assamese commander with an oval medium-brown face, black topknot hair and red headband, wearing an off-white tunic, forest-green quilted sleeveless coat, indigo trousers, brown boots, white-red sash, and carrying a long spear and round wooden shield.

gadadhar_singha.ref_desc: Gadadhar Singha appears as a mid-30s, wheatish-brown Assamese warrior with an oval face, small eyebrow scar, black hair in a tight top-knot with a red forehead band, wearing an off-white tunic, deep indigo quilted coat, mustard-ochre dhoti, red sash, brown sandals, and carrying a curved dao in a dark brown scabbard at his left hip.
