vasco_da_gama_and_the_zamorin.ref_desc: Vasco da Gama is a mid-30s, lean Portuguese captain with a light olive face, short dark brown hair and trimmed beard, wearing a dark navy doublet, off-white shirt, russet hose, black jerkin, brown boots, red sash, and carrying a rolled chart with brass dividers.

pedro_alvares_cabral_and_vasco_da_gama.figure: Pedro Alvares Cabral and Vasco da Gama
pedro_alvares_cabral_and_vasco_da_gama.ref_desc: Vasco da Gama is a mid-30s olive-skinned Portuguese admiral with wavy black hair, trimmed beard, crimson beret, navy doublet, black jerkin, brown cloak, hose and boots, carrying a brass-hilted cutlass, in a palette of navy, brown, black, cream and crimson.

zamorin_s_merchant_envoys.ref_desc: A late-30s Malabar merchant-envoy with a medium brown oval face, black hair in a low knot under a deep-green bordered turban, cream tunic, white trousers, maroon sash, dark-blue waistcoat, brown sandals, gold accents, and a red-cord bound parchment map with leather satchel.

kunjali_marakkar_i.ref_desc: Kunjali Marakkar I has a warm medium-brown oval face with a neat black beard, wavy shoulder-length hair tied under a dark indigo turban, an off-white angarkha over deep indigo sash, dark green vest, brown trousers, and carries a curved Malabar sword with wooden scabbard.

the_zamorin_and_kunjali_iii.ref_desc: The Zamorin has an ivory tunic, gold-bordered white mundu, deep-red silk shawl and plain steel talwar, while Kunjali III wears a dark indigo jama over white, brown leather belt, muted red sash and carries a worn steel talwar and river-map parchment, all in ivory, deep red, gold, dark indigo and brown.

kunjali_marakkar_iv.ref_desc: Kunjali Marakkar IV is a mid-40s, lean Malabar admiral with a neatly bearded oval face, black hair in a low knot under an indigo turban, wearing a cream angarkha, indigo vest, brown dhoti, crimson sash and off-white shawl, carrying a curved tulwar in a brown scabbard, in cream, indigo, brown, crimson and gold tones.

alauddin_bahman_shah.ref_desc: Alauddin Bahman Shah is a medium-tall Deccani man in his late 30s with a neat dark beard, calm stern eyes, a deep teal turban, teal-blue mail-and-plate armor under an indigo robe with gold piping, earthy brown trousers, dark leather boots, and a plain-hilted talwar at his left hip.

bande_nawaz_gesudaraz.ref_desc: Bande Nawaz Gesudaraz is an elderly medium-built Sufi with warm brown skin, a flowing grey beard, a simple white turban with a maroon band, wearing an off-white robe, cream trousers, a deep maroon shawl, brown leather slippers, and carrying a brown leather-bound manuscript.

taj_ud_din_firuz_shah_bahmani.ref_desc: Taj ud-Din Firuz Shah Bahmani is a mid-40s, wheatish-olive skinned scholar-king with a neat black beard, jade green domed turban, deep-blue striped qabā with cream over-robe, white churidar trousers, brown shoes, a dark brown-sheathed Deccan talwar at his left hip and a small book pouch at his belt.

mahmud_gawan.ref_desc: Mahmud Gawan is a tall, lean man in his late 40s with a wheatish-light brown oval face, salt-and-pepper beard, dark green quilted turban with a cream band and gold crescent brooch, wearing an emerald green Persian-style robe over cream garments with maroon belt and brown shoes, carrying a rolled parchment land-survey scroll at his waist with indigo and gold accents throughout.

hussain_nizam_shah_i_and_the_deccan_coal.figure: Hussain Nizam Shah I and the Deccan Coalition
hussain_nizam_shah_i_and_the_deccan_coal.ref_desc: Hussain Nizam Shah I is a mid-40s, wheatish-brown, sharp-featured man with an emerald-green turban, cream jama under a dark indigo quilted coat, white churidar trousers, olive-green shawl, maroon-belted talwar at his left hip and dark-brown riding boots.

yusuf_adil_shah_and_afonso_de_albuquerqu.figure: Yusuf Adil Shah and Afonso de Albuquerque
yusuf_adil_shah_and_afonso_de_albuquerqu.ref_desc: Afonso de Albuquerque is a compact, weathered Portuguese commander with short dark-brown hair, a trimmed greying beard, dark-navy doublet under a plain steel breastplate, deep-crimson sleeveless surcoat, brown hose and boots, and a simple arming sword in a brown scabbard.

malik_ambar.ref_desc: Malik Ambar is a deep-brown-skinned, oval-faced, short-bearded man in an off-white quilted jama over steel-grey mail, dark maroon waist-sash and baldric, deep indigo turban and riding cloak, white churidar trousers, brown leather boots, and a brass-edged talwar at his left hip.

abdullah_bin_kaiser_and_bidar_artisans.figure: Abdullah bin Kaiser and Bidar artisans
abdullah_bin_kaiser_and_bidar_artisans.ref_desc: Abdullah bin Kaiser is a late-30s lean craftsman with an oval wheatish face, neat black beard, dark indigo cap, off-white knee-length jama over sky-blue sleeves, maroon waist sash, light grey trousers, brown mojari shoes, carrying an unfinished blackened Bidriware hookah base and a slim steel inlay chisel.

ahmad_shah_i_and_the_karez_engineers.figure: Ahmad Shah I and the Karez Engineers
ahmad_shah_i_and_the_karez_engineers.ref_desc: Ahmad Shah I of Bidar is a sturdy, early-40s Bahmani sultan with an oval bearded face, short black hair under a deep-green turban, wearing an off-white striped jama, maroon quilted vest, light-brown trousers, dark-brown shoes, and carrying a rolled karez map with a wooden measuring rod.

qutb_shahi_sultans_and_tavernier.ref_desc: Mid‑40s Tavernier with light olive face, wavy shoulder‑length dark brown hair under a worn brown felt hat, wearing a dark navy quilted doublet, grey‑brown travel cloak, russet‑brown breeches and dark brown boots, holding a dark leather diamond sample case and brass loupe, in muted navy, brown and off‑white tones.

muhammad_quli_qutb_shah.ref_desc: Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah is a wheat-brown, oval-faced young Deccani sultan with a neat black beard, emerald conical turban, maroon striped silk jama, ivory churidar, turquoise shawl, pearl necklace, carrying a red-tied manuscript and a sheathed talwar at his hip.

ibrahim_adil_shah_ii.ref_desc: Ibrahim Adil Shah II has an oval wheatish face with trimmed black beard and calm dark eyes, short black hair under an emerald Deccani turban, wearing an off‑white patterned jama, dark teal overcoat, saffron sash, cream churidar, brown mojari, and carrying a dark wood tanpura‑like lute.

muhammad_adil_shah_and_bijapur_artists.figure: Muhammad Adil Shah and Bijapur Artists
muhammad_adil_shah_and_bijapur_artists.ref_desc: Muhammad Adil Shah is a medium-built, bearded Deccan sultan in a muted teal patterned jama with a maroon quilted waistcoat, cream sash, off-white churidar, dark brown shoes, a white conical turban with green plume, and a sheathed curved talwar at his side.

the_early_pandya_court_and_nedunjeliyan_.figure: The early Pandya court and Nedunjeliyan I
the_early_pandya_court_and_nedunjeliyan_.ref_desc: Nedunjeliyan of Madurai is a mid-30s athletic Tamil king with a medium-deep brown complexion, black topknot hair under a thin gold circlet and off-white headband, wearing a maroon tunic, off-white veshti with maroon border, mustard-yellow angavastram, simple gold and bronze jewellery, brown sandals, and carrying a leaf-shaped iron sword in a brown leather scabbard at his left hip in a maroon, mustard, off-white, brown, and gold palette.

the_pearl_divers_and_merchants_of_korkai.figure: The pearl divers and merchants of Korkai
the_pearl_divers_and_merchants_of_korkai.ref_desc: A wiry, sun-browned young man with an oval face, dark topknot and off-white headband, wearing an indigo short-sleeved tunic, off-white knee-length veshti with indigo border, sandy-beige sash, simple bronze and shell ornaments, and carrying a straw-coloured pearl-diving basket with coiled rope and stone weight.

kannagi_and_the_pandya_king_neduncheliya.figure: Kannagi and the Pandya king Neduncheliyan
kannagi_and_the_pandya_king_neduncheliya.ref_desc: Kannagi is a young Tamil woman with long black braided hair bound by red bands and jasmine, wearing a deep-red sari with golden-yellow border over a cream under-layer and modest jewellery, gripping a heavy golden anklet in her hand beside Neduncheliyan, a broad-shouldered king with shoulder-length tied-back black hair, a slim gold diadem, cream tunic, dark-teal dhoti, indigo shawl, modest gold ornaments, and a sheathed straight sword at his hip, all in a palette of deep red, gold, dark teal, cream, and indigo.

nedunjeliyan_ii.ref_desc: Nedunjeliyan II is a mid-30s, medium-dark Tamil king with an oval face, cheek scar, warrior topknot with a gold frontlet, maroon-bordered off-white veshti, deep blue upper cloth, leather-and-bronze chest harness, maroon shawl, gold fish-armlet, and a leaf-shaped bronze-hilted sword at his hip.

mankudi_maruthanar_and_sangam_era_madura.ref_desc: Mankudi Maruthanar is a mid-30s, lean, warm-brown-complexioned Tamil poet with an oval face, short beard, black hair in a low knot with a white headband, wearing an off-white veshti with dark-maroon border, pale-cream long-sleeved upper cloth, simple copper ornaments, brown sandals, and carrying a bound palm-leaf manuscript stack tied with a dark-maroon cord.

kadungon.ref_desc: Kadungon is a mid-30s, medium-brown king with an oval face, thin moustache, black hair in a high topknot with a narrow gold circlet, wearing an off-white veshti with deep-blue and gold borders, cream tunic, deep-blue fish-motif shawl, modest gold jewellery, and brown sandals, carrying a plain curved iron sword at his left hip and a small deep-blue twin-fish banner, with off-white, deep blue, gold, brown leather and black as his dominant colours.

jatila_parantaka_nedunjadaiyan.ref_desc: Jatila Parantaka Nedunjadaiyan is a mid-30s Pandya king with medium-brown skin, high black kudumi and gold circlet, maroon silk angavastram, off-white gold-bordered veshti, modest gold jewellery, brown sandals, and a rolled copper-plate charter tied with a green cord.

manikkavachakar.ref_desc: Manikkavachakar is a lean, medium-brown Tamil man in his early 40s with shoulder-length black hair, headband, vibhuti-marked serene face, off-white dhoti and shawl over a cream tunic, minimal rudraksha mala, sandals, and a maroon-tied palm-leaf manuscript bundle.

jatavarman_sundara_pandyan_i.ref_desc: Jatavarman Sundara Pandyan I is a late-30s medium-brown South Indian king with black hair in a low knot, gold Pandya crown-band, cream dhoti with maroon-gold border, golden-yellow draped upper cloth, maroon sash, gold jewellery, and a curved steel sword at his left hip.

maravarman_kulasekara_pandyan_i.ref_desc: Maravarman Kulasekara Pandyan I is a medium-brown, oval-faced Dravidian king with a high knotted black hair bun under a simple gold circlet, short moustache, off-white silk dhoti, maroon brocade vest, deep indigo upper cloth, modest gold jewellery and a leather-hilted South Indian sword at his left hip.

pandya_mint_masters.ref_desc: A mid-30s Pandya mint master with medium-brown skin, black topknot hair and gold forehead band, wearing an off-white dhoti, indigo upper cloth and tawny shawl, bronze armlets and leather belt, holding a bronze twin-fish coin die and iron hammer in an indigo-tawny palette.

amir_khusrau_and_vira_pandya.display_name: Amir Khusrau & Vira Pandya (Pandya War Arc)
amir_khusrau_and_vira_pandya.ref_desc: Amir Khusrau is a lean, wheatish-complexioned man in a light beige quilted jama with brown belt, off-white shawl, cap and manuscript, beside broad-shouldered Vira Pandya in deep maroon tunic, cream dhoti, steel breastplate, gold ornaments and dark red belt wielding a bronze-hilted steel sword.

the_builders_of_madurai_s_meenakshi_temp.figure: The builders of Madurai's Meenakshi Temple
the_builders_of_madurai_s_meenakshi_temp.ref_desc: Madurai Vishwakarma is a mid-30s Tamil sthapati with an oval medium-brown face, low-bun black hair and off-white headband, wearing an off-white angavastram and deep indigo golden-bordered veshti, carrying a palm-leaf manuscript and wooden measuring rod in warm off-white, indigo, brown, gold, and red tones.

faxian.ref_desc: Faxian is a lean, older Chinese monk with a shaved head, serene oval face, saffron-ochre and brick-red Indian-style robes over an off-white tunic, a brown sash and tan shoulder bag, holding a bamboo pilgrim staff with a bronze begging bowl attached.

nalanda_seal_makers_and_kumaragupta_i.display_name: Kumaragupta I as Shakraditya of Nalanda
nalanda_seal_makers_and_kumaragupta_i.figure: Nalanda seal makers and Kumaragupta I
nalanda_seal_makers_and_kumaragupta_i.ref_desc: A mid-30s wheatish Gupta emperor with oval face, short topknot hair and gold circlet, wearing ivory uttariya, maroon dhoti with dark green-gold border, modest necklace and armlets, and holding a clay seal over a wooden tray of seals in ivory, maroon, dark green, gold, and warm brown tones.

harsha_and_the_nalanda_stewards.ref_desc: Harsha is a medium-brown, oval-faced emperor with shoulder-length black hair and gold circlet, cream tunic, saffron dhoti, deep-red uttariya and palm-leaf grant, beside a squarer-faced steward in off-white dhoti, dull-green uttariya and wooden tally staff, in warm cream and red tones.

silabhadra_and_xuanzang.ref_desc: Xuanzang is a clean-shaven, light-ochre-robed Tang monk with gray-brown travel cloak, staff and dark-brown scroll case, beside Śīlabhadra, a frail clean-shaven Nalanda elder in saffron under-robe and red-brown kashaya, holding a palm-leaf manuscript, all in warm beige, ochre and dark brown tones.

yijing.ref_desc: Yijing is a lean early-40s monk with an oval warm-brown face, shaved head and small goatee, wearing a rust-red kashaya over beige tunic, dark brown trousers and sandals, carrying an indigo-tied palm-leaf manuscript bundle in a rust-red and beige palette.

nalanda_gate_scholars.ref_desc: A lean early-30s Nalanda gate scholar with an oval medium-brown face, black topknot and saffron headband, wearing cream tunic, reddish-brown dhoti, saffron robe, maroon shawl, leather sandals, and holding a red-cord-bound palm-leaf manuscript bundle.

dignaga_and_dharmakirti.ref_desc: Dignaga and Dharmakirti are two South Asian Buddhist scholar-monks with brown complexions, tonsured dark hair, saffron and maroon layered robes, simple sandals, each holding a palm-leaf manuscript (Dharmakirti also a stylus) in a warm saffron-maroon palette.

shantideva.ref_desc: Śāntideva is a slim early-30s monk with medium-brown oval face, short tonsured black hair and saffron headband, wearing maroon and saffron Nalanda-style triple robes to the ankles with brown sandals, carrying a palm-leaf Bodhicaryāvatāra manuscript and wooden rosary in a maroon-saffron-brown palette.

nalanda_s_monastic_seal_keepers.ref_desc: Nalanda Seal Keeper: early-forties monk with medium-brown oval face, short black hair and saffron headband, in off-white tunic, saffron robe, full-length dhoti and brown sandals, carrying a wooden seal block, ink pad and palm-leaf bundle in a saffron–off-white–dark brown palette.

dharmapala_s_architects_at_somapura.ref_desc: A mid-30s Bengal architect with medium-brown oval face, short beard, black hair in a low knot with reddish-brown headband, wearing an off-white dhoti with maroon border, pale yellow long tunic, brick-red shoulder cloth, brown sandals, and carrying a palm-leaf manuscript bundle with stylus and a notched wooden measuring rod.

vikramashila_builders_and_librarians.ref_desc: A lean medium-brown engineer-librarian with tied-back dark hair and headband, off-white dhoti, light indigo tunic, mango-yellow uttariya, maroon belt, simple copper jewellery, holding palm-leaf manuscript bundle and wooden measuring rod in off-white, yellow, indigo, maroon tones.

gunamati_and_sthiramati.ref_desc: Gunamati and Sthiramati are two lean, wheatish-complexioned young men with tied topknots, wearing angarkha robes over dhotis with maroon and indigo shawls, simple sandals and copper-bronze ornaments, jointly holding a maroon-wrapped palm-leaf manuscript bundle in a palette of off-white, saffron, maroon, indigo and pale grey-blue.

dharmasvamin_and_rahula_sribhadra.ref_desc: Dharmasvamin is a shaven-headed Tibetan monk in maroon and saffron robes with dark wooden beads and a palm-leaf manuscript bundle, beside aged Rahula Śrībhadra in faded saffron and cream robes with sandalwood beads and a wooden staff, using maroon, saffron, cream, dark brown and grey tones.

the_85_meerut_troopers.display_name: Meerut Trooper of the 3rd Bengal Cavalry
the_85_meerut_troopers.ref_desc: A lean, mid-1850s Purbiya cavalryman with navy-blue tunic, cream churidar, deep red turban and waist sash, brown leather belts and boots, brass details, carrying a Pattern 1853 Enfield rifle and sheathed talwar, in a resolute, dignified anime style.

azimullah_khan.ref_desc: Azimullah Khan has an oval medium-brown face with a neat moustache, short black hair under a maroon pagri, cream angarkha, navy chapkan, off-white churidar, brown mojari, grey-blue shawl, and carries a compact dark-iron printing press with papers.

bakht_khan_rohilla.ref_desc: Bakht Khan Rohilla is a late‑middle‑aged, broad‑shouldered man with a grey‑streaked beard, deep maroon Rohilla turban, indigo angarkha, quilted olive vest, off‑white churidar trousers, brown leather shoes and belt, carrying a curved brass‑mounted sword in a brown scabbard.

nana_sahib_and_azimullah_khan.ref_desc: Nana Sahib has an oval wheatish face, maroon turban, cream angarkha, maroon sash and paisa coin with talwar at his belt, beside lean Azimullah in dark green angarkha, green turban, beige trousers, brown shoes and cream shawl, all in cream-maroon-green-gold tones.

khan_bahadur_khan_rohilla.ref_desc: Khan Bahadur Khan Rohilla is an elderly Rohilla leader with an oval wheatish face, grey hair under a maroon conical turban, white angarkha and churidar, dark indigo waistcoat, forest-green sash and shawl, brown mojaris, and a brass-hilted talwar in a brown scabbard.

mark_thornhill_and_telegraph_operators.ref_desc: Mark Thornhill is a lean, sun-tanned British magistrate with neat short dark brown hair, cream sun helmet, light khaki tunic coat, dark olive trousers, brown riding boots, and always carries a rolled telegraph dispatch and worn leather notebook in a khaki-and-brown palette.

ahmadullah_shah.ref_desc: Ahmadullah Shah is a lean, medium-brown man in a white kurta, dark green angarkha coat, maroon sash, beige chadar, brown boots, white turban with green band, and a brass-hilt talwar at his left hip in a brown scabbard.

bakht_khan_john_nicholson_and_william_ho.figure: Bakht Khan, John Nicholson and William Hodson
bakht_khan_john_nicholson_and_william_ho.ref_desc: Bakht Khan is a mid-40s sturdy, bearded North Indian rebel officer with a deep-red conical turban, green quilted angarkha coat over cream kurta and white pyjamas, dark-red waist sash, brown boots, carrying a brass-hilted curved sword and rolled map in deep red, green, cream and brown tones.

mirza_ghalib_and_bahadur_shah_zafar.display_name: Mirza Ghalib & Bahadur Shah Zafar (Dual Witnesses)
mirza_ghalib_and_bahadur_shah_zafar.figure: Mirza Ghalib and Bahadur Shah Zafar
mirza_ghalib_and_bahadur_shah_zafar.ref_desc: An older Mirza Ghalib in a beige angarkha, off-white churidar, grey shawl and reddish-brown cap with a leather book pouch, beside frail Bahadur Shah Zafar in a cream jama, maroon sash, pastel green shawl and dark green turban holding reed pen and paper.

awadh_talukdars_and_sepoy_families.ref_desc: Raghav Singh is a lean late‑20s Awadh talukdar’s son with medium‑brown skin, moustache, deep red turban over black hair knot, off‑white angarkha, pale yellow kurta, indigo sash, brown churidar trousers, olive shawl and a brass‑hilt talwar at his hip.

kaye_savarkar_sen_and_guha.ref_desc: A lean mid-30s scholar with an oval medium-light brown face, short wavy black hair, thin moustache and goatee, in a charcoal Nehru coat, off-white churidar, maroon stole and black shoes, carrying a tan leather satchel and an 1857-marked book.

queen_victoria_and_lord_canning.ref_desc: Queen Victoria in black 1850s silk dress, lace collar and bonnet with low bun hair stands beside Lord Canning in dark navy frock coat, cream waistcoat and red ceremonial sash, holding a rolled parchment and leather dispatch case in a black, white and deep red palette.

nana_sahib_mowbray_thomson_and_colonel_n.display_name: Nana Sahib (with Mowbray Thomson & Colonel Neill ensemble)
nana_sahib_mowbray_thomson_and_colonel_n.figure: Nana Sahib, Mowbray Thomson and Colonel Neill
nana_sahib_mowbray_thomson_and_colonel_n.ref_desc: Nana Sahib has a medium-brown oval face, red turban, off-white angarkha with maroon sash and dark green waistcoat, bearing a sheathed talwar; beside him Thomson in navy tunic and khaki trousers with a plain sword, and Neill in scarlet uniform with sabre, using off-white, maroon, dark green, navy and scarlet tones.

panchanan_karmakar_and_the_serampore_tri.figure: Panchanan Karmakar and the Serampore Trio
panchanan_karmakar_and_the_serampore_tri.ref_desc: Panchanan Karmakar is a mid-40s lean Bengali artisan with wavy black hair in a short low knot, an off-white dhoti, cream angarkha, indigo shawl, copper bangle and gold ear studs, holding a wooden composing stick with Bengali metal type amid warm brown and off-white tones.

rammohun_roy.ref_desc: Rammohun Roy appears as a thoughtful middle-aged Bengali man with a deep blue silk turban, oval wheatish face and spectacles, wearing a white dhoti, off-white jama, dark indigo shawl with gold trim, holding a rolled manuscript and simple walking stick.

rammohun_roy_and_lord_william_bentinck.figure: Rammohun Roy and Lord William Bentinck
rammohun_roy_and_lord_william_bentinck.ref_desc: Rammohun Roy is a late-middle-aged Bengali man with an oval light-brown face, short black hair under a mustard-yellow turban, white jama and dhoti, indigo shawl, brown sandals, spectacles, and he carries a rolled petition and a leather-bound book in indigo, mustard, maroon, white, and brown tones.

henry_louis_vivian_derozio.ref_desc: Henry Louis Vivian Derozio is a fair-complexioned young Anglo-Indian man with wavy dark brown hair brushed back, wearing a white high-collared shirt, dark navy tailcoat, light beige trousers and black shoes, holding a leather-bound poetry notebook with quill and pamphlet accents.

dwarkanath_tagore.ref_desc: Dwarkanath Tagore is a refined Bengali man in his early 40s with an oval wheatish face, combed-back black hair and velvet cap, wearing a white angarkha, churidar and dark navy silk shawl, holding a rolled red-tied business contract in one hand.

madhusudan_gupta.ref_desc: Madhusudan Gupta is a light-brown–skinned, early-40s Bengali physician with an oval face, round spectacles, dark hair under a plain white turban, wearing an off-white kurta, white dhoti, beige shawl with maroon border, brown slippers, and carrying a worn dark-brown anatomical atlas with a tucked scalpel.

ishwar_chandra_vidyasagar.ref_desc: A mid-30s lean Bengali man with an oval face, short side-parted black hair, calm serious eyes, wearing an off-white dhoti, white kurta, cream shawl with muted red border, brown sandals, and carrying a thick Sanskrit manuscript and a red-tied petition scroll.

michael_madhusudan_dutt.ref_desc: Michael Madhusudan Dutt is a mid-19th century Bengali gentleman with wavy black hair combed back, oval light-brown face with moustache and sideburns, wearing a navy frock coat, white shirt, black trousers, off-white maroon-bordered shawl, and carrying a worn brown manuscript notebook with a pen.

bankim_chandra_chatterjee.ref_desc: A mid-40s Bengali man with medium-brown skin, oval face, short black hair under a deep-indigo turban, white kurta and off-white dhoti with indigo border under a dark-navy colonial coat, dark-brown shoes, carrying a leather-bound manuscript notebook and wooden dip-pen in a white, indigo and cream palette.

abanindranath_tagore_and_e_b_havell.ref_desc: Abanindranath Tagore is a slim late-30s Bengali man in cream kurta, beige dhoti, off-white shawl, brown sandals, dark wavy hair and headband holding a wooden drawing board and bamboo brush beside E.B. Havell, a fair mid-40s Englishman in charcoal-grey suit, white shirt, deep-blue tie and brown shoes holding a brown notebook and metal pen, using a cream, off-white, beige, charcoal and deep-blue palette.

rabindranath_tagore.ref_desc: Rabindranath Tagore is a tall, slightly stooped man in his fifties with a long grey wavy shoulder-length hair, flowing beard and moustache, serene deep-set eyes, wearing a cream kurta, off-white dhoti, ankle-length dark indigo robe, brown sandals, and carrying a dark brown notebook with a simple wooden pen, in a palette of cream, dark indigo, off-white, warm brown, and soft grey.

begum_rokeya_sakhawat_hussain.ref_desc: Begum Rokeya is a brown-skinned woman in her late 30s with an oval face, large thoughtful eyes, black hair in a low bun under a white muslin sari with a dark green border, cream long-sleeved blouse, simple gold bangles and nose pin, worn brown ledger and chalk holder, in white, green, cream, brown and gold tones.

kazi_nazrul_islam.ref_desc: Kazi Nazrul Islam is a mid-20s lean Bengali man with shoulder-length black hair under an off-white Gandhi cap, wearing an off-white khadi panjabi, white dhoti, light khadi chador and brown sandals, always carrying a brown leather-bound notebook with a wooden fountain pen, in a warm off-white and brown palette.

velu_nachiyar.ref_desc: Rani Velu Nachiyar is a late-20s athletic Tamil queen with warm brown skin, sharp dark eyes, a small bindi, long black hair in a jasmine-wrapped low bun under a deep-red cloth headwrap, wearing an indigo sari with maroon border in practical warrior drape over a maroon blouse, a dark-brown leather jerkin with modest steel breastplate, mustard cloth belt, brown sandals, modest gold jewellery, and carrying a curved South Indian steel sword with a brass hilt and brown leather scabbard.

surendranath_banerjee.ref_desc: Surendranath Banerjee is a mid-40s medium-brown man with an oval face, neat black mustache, short-parted black hair under a white Bengal turban, wearing a white kurta, off-white gold-bordered dhoti, cream shawl, carrying a dark-navy coat and a rolled newspaper in a white-cream-pale-gold-dark-navy palette.

mahatma_gandhi.ref_desc: A very lean late-40s Mahatma Gandhi with narrow oval brown face, thin moustache, round glasses, almost shaved thinning hair, wearing off-white khadi kurta and mid-calf dhoti with a light-beige shawl and brown sandals, holding a plain wooden walking stick.

sarojini_naidu.ref_desc: Sarojini Naidu is a mid‑50s, medium‑brown woman with a rounded face, grey hair in a low bun under a white khadi sari pallu, wearing an off‑white khadi sari with deep‑blue border, indigo blouse, simple silver jewellery and sandals, carrying a slender wooden staff with a rolled off‑white banner.

reginald_dyer.ref_desc: Reginald Dyer is a mid‑50s, pale British officer with a long angular face, narrow grey‑blue eyes, a neat dark blond moustache, short side‑parted hair under a khaki service cap, wearing a crisp khaki British Indian Army tunic, trousers, puttees, brown leather Sam Browne belt and boots, and carrying a dark brown wooden swagger stick, in a palette of dusty khaki, pale beige, dark brown leather, muted olive and steel grey‑blue.

lakshmi_sahgal.ref_desc: Lakshmi Sahgal is a calm, medium-brown–skinned woman in her early 30s with dark eyes and dark hair in a low bun, wearing a neat long-sleeved khaki INA shirt, ankle-length khaki skirt, brown ankle boots, INA tricolour armband, and a brown leather crossbody medical satchel with a visible stethoscope.

usha_mehta.ref_desc: Usha Mehta is a petite early-20s woman with a light-brown oval face, round steel glasses, black hair in a low bun, wearing an off-white khadi sari with a dark-green border and blouse, carrying a boxy shortwave radio transmitter and paper sheets in off-white, dark green, brown leather, steel grey and black tones.

kartar_singh_sarabha.ref_desc: Kartar Singh Sarabha is a slim 18-year-old Punjabi youth with a medium-brown complexion, black hair under a small navy-blue turban, wearing an off-white kurta, light beige salwar, charcoal-grey Western wool coat, brown shoes, a brown shawl, and carrying a rolled Ghadar newspaper and a simple steel fountain pen in a muted off-white, charcoal grey, navy blue, beige and brown palette.

b_r_ambedkar.ref_desc: Dr B. R. Ambedkar is a medium-height, stocky, early-50s man with a rounded face, medium brown skin, short combed-back black hair with a left part, gold-rimmed round glasses, wearing a navy blue single-breasted suit, white shirt, maroon tie, black shoes, and carrying a thick dark brown hardbound constitution-style book with cream legal papers tied in red.

dadabhai_naoroji.ref_desc: Dadabhai Naoroji is an elderly Parsi man with light-brown complexion, round spectacles, a neatly trimmed full white beard, short white hair under a tall black pagadi cap, wearing a dark navy frock coat over cream shirt, maroon cravat, grey waistcoat and charcoal trousers, carrying a brown leather portfolio, in a palette of dark navy, charcoal grey, cream, black and maroon.

pingali_venkayya.ref_desc: Pingali Venkayya is a lean, medium-brown man in his late 40s with short salt-and-pepper hair, small round spectacles, a white khadi cap, off-white khadi kurta and South Indian dhoti with a pale-cream angavastram, brown sandals, a diagonal khadi bag, and a rolled saffron-white-green flag with navy Ashoka Chakra under his arm and flag design sketches in his hand.

bhulabhai_desai.ref_desc: Bhulabhai Desai is a mid-50s medium-built man with an oval face, small moustache, short greying hair under an off-white Gandhi cap, wearing a white kurta, white churidar trousers, black barrister’s coat and gown, black shoes, and carrying a brown leather case file folder in a black-and-off-white palette.

vassakara_ananda_and_the_vajji_confedera.figure: Vassakara, Ananda and the Vajji Confederation
vassakara_ananda_and_the_vajji_confedera.ref_desc: Vassakara is a mid-40s, lean North Indian man with an oval face, medium-brown complexion, short beard, black hair in a tight low knot with a narrow gold headband, wearing a cream uttariya, muted maroon ankle-length dhoti, light-brown sleeveless vest with dark-red edging, plain brown belt, simple sandals, minimal gold jewellery, and carrying a rolled palm-leaf manuscript bundle with a wooden stylus, in a cream, maroon, brown and gold palette.

the_licchavi_santhagara.ref_desc: Licchavi Saṅghāma is a wheat-brown, sharp-jawed man in his early 30s with a neat short beard, black hair in a high topknot with a dark-red band and bronze circlet, wearing an off-white tunic, deep-saffron dhoti, light-grey uttariya shawl, simple bronze jewellery, and brown sandals, always carrying a polished wooden salaka tally rod and flat ballot tray in a palette of off-white, deep saffron, light grey, dark red and bronze brown.

vardhamana_mahavira_and_chetaka.ref_desc: Mahavira is a lean wheat-brown man with an oval face, calm wide eyes, dark-brown hair in a simple back knot, dressed in plain off-white upper and lower cloths and carrying an off-white peacock-feather whisk, while Chetaka is a broad-shouldered, bearded darker-brown man with a neat topknot, wearing a muted indigo long-sleeved tunic over a pale-cream lower wrap with a dark-maroon waist sash, simple bronze jewellery and sandals, holding a wooden-shaft spear with an iron tip.

the_shakya_and_koliya_republics.ref_desc: Young medium-brown man with oval face, black topknot hair, off-white long-sleeved tunic, reddish-brown dhoti, dark-blue shawl, brown leather belt and sandals, minimal copper jewellery, and a plain shoulder-height wooden staff as his constant prop, in these fixed colours.

cunda_and_the_malla_republic_of_pava.figure: Cunda and the Malla Republic of Pava
cunda_and_the_malla_republic_of_pava.ref_desc: Cunda of Pava is a lean early-30s north Indian metalworker with medium-brown skin, short wavy black hair held by a white headband, a neat short beard, wearing an off-white tunic, saffron-brown shawl, muted indigo trousers, brown sandals, copper bangle and ear stud, and always carrying a worn iron hammer with a red-wrapped handle.

dona_and_the_eight_claimant_states.figure: Dona and the Eight Claimant States
dona_and_the_eight_claimant_states.ref_desc: Dona is a medium-built, bearded brahmin in off-white ankle-length dhoti, saffron-beige draped upper cloth and cream diagonal sash over a light-brown under-tunic, with dark tied-back hair, headband, wooden beads, copper bangle and a banded clay reliquary urn in his hands.

the_karshapana_coin_makers.ref_desc: A mid-20s lean North Indian man with medium-brown complexion, black topknot hair and a forehead cloth band, wearing an off-white dhoti, light indigo tunic, reddish-brown bordered shawl and leather sandals, holding a stone anvil, hammer, sun-symbol punch and silver karshapana coins in off-white, indigo, brown and silver tones.

northern_black_polished_ware_artisans.ref_desc: A lean late‑20s north Indian potter with medium‑brown skin, black hair in a short topknot, calm dark eyes, off‑white dhoti and angarkha, mid‑brown shawl, red belt, bronze bangle, sandals, holding a glossy black NBPW bowl and a wooden potter’s tool.

rajgir_s_cyclopean_wall_builders.ref_desc: A lean early-30s Magadhan stone-mason with medium-brown skin, black hair in a short topknot with an off-white headband, wearing an off-white dhoti, brown short-sleeved tunic, grey-beige shoulder cloth, dark brown sandals, and carrying a wooden lever-pole and stone chisel in earthy browns and off-whites.

kausambi_s_rampart_builders_and_merchant.ref_desc: A lean, medium-brown man in an indigo tunic, pale ochre ankle-length dhoti, off-white shawl, leather sandals, headbanded topknot, simple bangles and amulet, always carrying a wooden measuring rod, in a palette of indigo, off-white, pale ochre, brown and bronze.

pradyota_and_the_ujjain_traders.ref_desc: Pradyota is a wiry mid-30s king with medium-brown skin, shoulder-length black hair in a low knot with a white headband, wearing an off-white angarkha, deep indigo shawl, brick-red dhoti, leather sandals, copper jewellery, and carrying a simple iron sword and a pouch of punch-marked coins.

ahichhatra_s_excavators_and_panchala_mem.ref_desc: A mid-30s lean male archaeologist with an oval wheat-brown face, short wavy black hair under a khaki cloth cap, wearing a khaki cotton bush shirt and trousers with brown boots and off-white scarf, holding a rolled excavation plan and wooden measuring staff in dusty khaki-brown tones.

the_gana_sangha_sources_problem.ref_desc: A lean mid-30s scholar with medium-brown skin, oval face, dark eyes and low ponytail under a cream headband, wearing an off-white kurta, deep indigo sleeveless vest, brick-red waist sash, brownish-grey trousers, beige bordered shawl, thin spectacles, and carrying a bundled palm-leaf and paper scroll set tied with leather and coloured tags.

venad_and_travancore.display_name: Venad Nair Captain of Pepper Routes
venad_and_travancore.ref_desc: A late-20s lean Nair captain with medium-brown complexion, black hair in a low knot with white headband and red tilak, wearing off-white mundu and long-sleeved angarakha with cream kasavu-bordered shawl and simple jewellery, carrying a curved Malabar sword in a brown scabbard with red waist-belt in off-white, cream, dark red, gold and dark brown tones.

marthanda_varma.ref_desc: Young Marthanda Varma has a medium-brown oval face with a sandal tilak, black hair in a low knot with a white band and gold forehead chain, wearing a deep-teal angarakha, off‑white kasavu mundu with maroon-gold border, cream shawl, simple gold jewellery and sandals, carrying a slim curved steel sword in a dark wooden scabbard at his left hip.

marthanda_varma_and_the_ettuveetil_pilla.figure: Marthanda Varma and the Ettuveetil Pillamar
marthanda_varma_and_the_ettuveetil_pilla.ref_desc: Marthanda Varma is a lean, medium‑brown man of about 30 with long black hair in a low knot under a deep red headcloth, wearing an off‑white double mundu, cream angarkha, red‑and‑gold shawl, minimal gold jewellery and a Malabar‑style sword at his left hip.

marthanda_varma_and_eustachius_de_lannoy.figure: Marthanda Varma and Eustachius De Lannoy
marthanda_varma_and_eustachius_de_lannoy.ref_desc: Marthanda Varma is a medium-brown, sharp-eyed Kerala ruler in maroon upper cloth, off-white dhoti with maroon border, gold belt and jewellery, black hair in a high knot with a gold band, holding a curved sword, beside De Lannoy, a light-complexioned, ash-brown-haired Dutch officer in a navy coat, cream waistcoat, tan breeches, and brown leather gear holding a flintlock musket.

marthanda_varma_and_ramayyan_dalawa.ref_desc: Marthanda Varma is a medium-brown, oval-faced Kerala king with oiled black hair in a knot under a small dark-red gold-bordered turban, in off-white long-sleeved angarkha, deep-red kasavu-bordered mundu, cream-gold shawl and brown sandals, carrying a curved sword at his hip, beside Ramayyan, a medium-brown, lean official with oiled hair knot and off-white headband, in a simple off-white long-sleeved kurta, pastel-green mundu, off-white angavastram and wooden sandals, holding a rolled palm-leaf manuscript and stylus; their shared palette is off-white, deep red, gold, pastel green and dark brown.

ramayyan_dalawa.ref_desc: Ramayyan Dalawa is a mid-40s lean Tamil Brahmin minister with wheatish skin, sharp oval face, small black moustache, oiled hair in a back kudumi, wearing an off-white veshti with golden-yellow border, indigo-blue cotton jacket, off-white angavastram with maroon stripe, simple gold accents, and carrying a slim curved steel sword in a brown scabbard plus a tied palm-leaf manuscript bundle in a restrained off-white, indigo, golden-yellow, maroon and dark-brown palette.

marthanda_varma_s_revenue_officers.ref_desc: A lean, medium-brown Travancore revenue officer with an oval face, black hair in a low bun under a simple white headcloth, wearing an off-white mundu with mustard-gold and dark-green border, cream angarkha and shawl, carrying a tied palm-leaf survey bundle with bamboo stylus and a small wooden measuring rod in off-white, mustard-gold, dark green and dark brown tones.

eustachius_de_lannoy.ref_desc: Eustachius De Lannoy is a tall, mid-40s European officer with ash-brown collar-length hair under a navy tricorn, tanned oval face with grey-blue eyes and trimmed beard, wearing a navy coat, cream waistcoat, red sash, buff breeches, brown boots, and carrying a brass-hilted smallsword plus a rolled map.

travancore_court_architects.ref_desc: A mid-30s medium-brown man with an oval face, neat mustache, black hair in a back knot with white headband, wearing an off-white mundu with maroon-gold border, cream angarakha, reddish-brown striped shawl and sandals, carrying a palm-leaf manuscript bundle with stylus and a wooden drawing board, in off-white, maroon, reddish-brown and mustard tones.

kunchan_nambiar.ref_desc: Kunchan Nambiar is a lean medium-brown Kerala man with an oval face, lively eyes, oiled black hair in a low knot with a white headband, wearing an off-white long-sleeved upper wrap, white mundu with green and red borders, red waist-belt, simple brass ornaments, and carrying a tied palm-leaf manuscript bundle with a wooden stylus, in off-white, leaf green, deep red, warm brown and brass gold tones.

dharma_raja_karthika_thirunal_rama_varma.display_name: Dharma Raja Karthika Thirunal Rama Varma
dharma_raja_karthika_thirunal_rama_varma.figure: Dharma Raja Karthika Thirunal Rama Varma
dharma_raja_karthika_thirunal_rama_varma.ref_desc: Dharma Raja Karthika Thirunal Rama Varma is a medium-brown, oval-faced Travancore king with black hair tied in a low knot and a slim gold headband, wearing an off-white angarakha, cream mundu with gold border, deep maroon shalya, minimal gold jewellery, carrying a rolled Nedumkotta map and a sheathed steel talwar, in a palette of off-white, cream, deep maroon, gold and dark brown.

bappa_rawal.ref_desc: Bappa Rawal is a mid-20s wheat-brown Rajput warrior with shoulder-length wavy black hair under a deep saffron turban, indigo quilted coat over off-white garments, sand-colored trousers, brown boots, red waist sash, beige shoulder-cloak, and a plain curved iron sword at his left hip.

maharana_hammir_singh.ref_desc: Maharana Hammir Singh is a mid-30s Rajput warrior with wheatish complexion, curved moustache, black hair under a saffron turban, wearing an off-white quilted angarkha, steel-grey mail vest, beige churidar, dark red sash, brown boots, and carrying a curved talwar at his left hip.

maharana_kumbha.ref_desc: Maharana Kumbha is a tall, broad-shouldered Rajput in a white angarkha under an indigo quilted war-coat, deep red turban with white feather, maroon shawl, off-white churidar, brown boots, leather bracers, and a talwar at his hip with a slung map case, in red, indigo, gold and off-white tones.

sutradhar_jaita_and_maharana_kumbha.ref_desc: A mid-40s wiry architect, Sutradhar Jaita, in off-white angarkha, mustard dhoti, simple cream shawl and turban with palm-leaf plans and measuring rod stands beside a broad-shouldered Maharana Kumbha in deep maroon quilted coat, green lower garment, red turban and brown-leather-belted talwar.

dharna_shah_and_deepaka.ref_desc: Dharna Shah and architect Deepaka are two early‑40s, medium‑brown men with oval faces, black hair in simple turbans, wearing off‑white and indigo Maru‑Gurjara‑era angarkha and jama outfits with dhoti and churidar, holding a rolled palm‑leaf architectural plan, wooden measuring rod and brass compass in off‑white, cream, indigo, saffron and brown tones.

rani_karnavati_of_mewar.ref_desc: Rani Karnavati is a wheatish-complexioned Rajput queen in her early 30s with large brown eyes, a tilak, black hair covered by a saffron-orange odhni, wearing a deep crimson silk lehenga, golden-beige angarkha, rich jewellery and brown mojari, carrying a plain dark-red sheathed Rajput talwar at her left hip.

maharana_amar_singh_i.ref_desc: Maharana Amar Singh I is a late-30s lean Rajput with medium-brown complexion, oval face and neat upturned moustache, wearing a saffron-orange Mewar pagri, white angarkha, maroon quilted sleeveless coat, off-white churidar, mustard-yellow patka, steel-gray mail accents and brown mojari, carrying a curved Rajput talwar in a dark-brown scabbard.

panna_dai.ref_desc: Panna Dai is a resolute early-30s Rajput nurse with an oval wheatish face, long black hair in a low bun under an off-white dupatta, wearing a dusty red ghagra, indigo angarkha blouse, mustard kamarband, simple brass jewellery, brown mojari slippers, and always carrying a covered woven reed basket.

rana_punja.ref_desc: Rana Punja is a lean, medium-brown, sharp-eyed Bhil leader with a low-tied black hair knot and indigo headwrap, wearing an olive-green angarkha, beige dhoti, brick-red shoulder shawl, dark brown belt and sandals, and carrying a dark wooden Bhil longbow with a back quiver of arrows.

maharana_pratap.ref_desc: Maharana Pratap is a tall, broad-shouldered Rajput in an off-white quilted angarkha over steel-grey mail, crimson waist sash, white churidar, brown leather boots, saffron turban with green band and white egret feather, carrying a curved steel talwar in a brown scabbard.

bhama_shah.ref_desc: Bhama Shah is a mid-30s lean Oswal Jain banker with wheatish skin, short black hair under an off-white pagri, wearing an off-white angarkha, turmeric-yellow churidar, deep-maroon waistband, ivory dupatta, brown mojari shoes, and carrying a dark-wood brass-fitted portable account chest.

sahibdin.ref_desc: Sahibdin is a medium-brown, oval-faced man in his late 30s with a short beard, black hair in a knot under a close white turban, wearing an off-white angarkha, light-cream churidar, saffron patka, red belt and brown mojari, carrying a red wooden portfolio and a slim brush.

nannuka.ref_desc: Nannuka is a lean mid-30s Chandela warrior with an oval medium-brown face, black hair in a topknot and red headband, wearing an off-white angarkha under an olive quilted coat, maroon waist wrap, indigo trousers, brown boots, khaki shawl, and carrying a dark recurved bow with brown quiver.

yashovarman.ref_desc: Yashovarman is a medium-brown, sharp-cheeked warrior-king in his early 30s with a black topknot, gold brow circlet, crimson angarkha over off-white shirt, indigo waist sash, beige trousers, bronze breastplate and bracers, and a plain iron sword in a brown leather scabbard.

dhanga.ref_desc: Dhanga-deva Chandela is a wheatish-brown, oval-faced ruler with a neat mustache, black hair in a high topknot with a gold circlet, wearing an off-white angarkha over a pale tunic, deep maroon dhoti, indigo quilted vest, forest-green shawl, modest gold jewellery, brown sandals, and a maroon-sheathed straight sword at his left hip.

vidyadhara.ref_desc: Vidyādhara Chandela is a mid-40s athletic north Indian king with an oval medium-brown face, black hair in a back knot under a gold circlet, wearing an indigo padded war-coat over a reddish-brown tunic, off-white trousers, ochre angavastra, gold armlets, and carrying a curved sword in a brown scabbard on a diagonal chest belt.

alha_and_udal.ref_desc: Alha is a late-20s, medium-brown Bundelkhand warrior with a scarred left cheek, black hair in a high topknot under a plain steel helmet and maroon headband, wearing off-white angarkha, steel mail and breastplate, forest-green sash, dark indigo trousers, maroon shawl, brown boots, iron bracers and earrings, and carrying a simple steel talwar in a brown leather scabbard.

devangana_desai.ref_desc: Devangana Desai is a late-middle-aged, medium-brown woman with oval face, glasses, dark grey-black hair in a low bun, wearing a teal sari with maroon border, maroon blouse, brown sandals, silver watch, beige crossbody satchel, and holding a sketchbook with temple outlines.

madanavarman.ref_desc: Madanavarman Chandela is a medium-brown, sharp-cheeked man in his late 30s with a small tilak, black hair in a topknot with a simple gold circlet, wearing an off-white angarkha, maroon quilted vest, deep indigo dhoti, ochre sash, light cream shawl, minimal gold jewellery, and carrying a wooden measuring staff with a tied palm-leaf map, in off-white, deep indigo, maroon, ochre and warm gold tones.

satyabhama_and_the_samantas.ref_desc: Satyabhama is a late‑20s Chandela noblewoman with an oval medium‑brown face, large sharp eyes, long black braided hair with a simple gold circlet, wearing a deep‑maroon wrapped skirt, leaf‑green blouse, saffron‑gold draped shawl, modest gold jewellery, and holding a rolled copper‑plate grant sealed with a small circular seal.

jain_merchant_patrons.ref_desc: A mid-30s Jain merchant with an oval medium-brown face, neat moustache, black hair in a low bun with a white head band, wearing an off-white angarkha, light-cream shawl, light-ochre dhoti, maroon borders, brown sandals, and holding rolled palm-leaf documents on a wooden tablet.

chhichha.ref_desc: Chhichha is a lean, medium-brown man in his late 30s with an oval face, black hair in a low knot with a white headband, wearing an off-white tunic, pale-cream shawl, earthy-ochre ankle-length dhoti, brown sandals, simple copper ornaments, and carrying a wooden measuring rod and bundled iron chisels in warm ochre and reddish-brown tones.

ibn_battuta_and_t_s_burt.display_name: Ibn Battuta & T.S. Burt in the Chandela Afterlife
ibn_battuta_and_t_s_burt.ref_desc: Ibn Battuta and T.S. Burt stand side by side, Ibn in a cream jubba with sky-blue under-tunic, deep-red sash, white turban and brown sandals holding a leather journal, Burt in khaki frock coat, beige trousers, forest-green waistcoat and brown boots holding a rolled survey map, both in cream, deep red, sky blue, khaki and brown leather tones.

mularaja_i.ref_desc: Mularaja I is a medium-built, brown-skinned warrior-king in his early 40s with an oval face, trimmed moustache-beard, black hair in a small back knot under a simple gold circlet, wearing a deep maroon angarkha, indigo quilted vest, white dhoti, ochre shawl, brown boots, and carrying a curved steel sword at his left side.

bhima_i_and_the_paramaras_of_malwa.figure: Bhima I and the Paramaras of Malwa
bhima_i_and_the_paramaras_of_malwa.ref_desc: Bhima I is a sturdy, medium-brown-complexioned warrior-king with a high black topknot, simple conical gold crown-band, cream angarakha, bronze lamellar cuirass, dark-red patka sash, indigo uttariya, off-white trousers, brown sandals, and a curved talwar in a dark-brown scabbard on a red shoulder belt.

vimal_shah.ref_desc: Vimal Shah is a late‑30s Jain minister with an oval light‑brown face, short dark hair under a deep‑maroon cloth turban, wearing an off‑white angarakha, mustard sash, maroon shawl, brown sandals, modest gold jewellery, and carrying a sealed parchment scroll and wooden writing board.

jayasimha_siddharaja.ref_desc: Jayasimha Siddharaja is a tall, athletic, wheatish-complexioned king with an oval face, black topknot under a simple conical golden crown-band, wearing a deep maroon quilted coat over a cream tunic, off-white dhoti with indigo under-wrap, saffron-yellow angavastra, brown leather belt and shoes, minimal gold jewellery, and carrying a plain curved steel sword in a dark brown leather scabbard at his right hip.

hemachandra.ref_desc: Hemachandra is a slender, mid‑40s Jain scholar with a high‑foreheaded oval, medium‑brown face, short black hair with a narrow white headband, wrapped in off‑white full‑length cotton robes and sandals, carrying a red‑tied bundle of palm‑leaf manuscripts with one leaf in hand.

jayasimha_siddharaja_and_the_od_builders.figure: Jayasimha Siddharaja and the Od builders
jayasimha_siddharaja_and_the_od_builders.ref_desc: Jayasimha Siddharaja is a medium-tall, wheatish-complexioned Chaulukya king with a trimmed moustache and beard, black hair in a topknot with a gold circlet, wearing a deep red angarkha, indigo quilted vest, cream dhoti and sash, simple gold jewellery, brown sandals, and carrying a diagonal-strap dark leather palm-leaf map case with brass ends in a palette of deep red, indigo, cream, golden yellow and brown leather.

kumarapala_and_hemachandra.ref_desc: Kumarapala is a wheat-brown, bearded king in a deep maroon angarakha, golden-yellow vest, white dhoti, cream striped shawl, red-and-gold turban and sheathed sword, standing beside the lean, clean-shaven Hemachandra in simple off-white Jain robes with a beige shawl and a rolled palm-leaf manuscript, all in maroon, gold, off-white, cream and brown tones.

merchants_of_khambhat.ref_desc: A mid-40s Jain merchant from Khambhat with a wheatish oval face, short beard, off-white turban, off-white angarkha and dhoti, marigold waistcoat, indigo shawl, brown mojari shoes, and a wooden writing board holding palm-leaf roll, stylus, coins and carnelian beads.

bhima_i_and_the_modhera_sthapatis.figure: Bhima I and the Modhera sthapatis
bhima_i_and_the_modhera_sthapatis.ref_desc: Bhima I is a broad-shouldered, medium-brown man with a low-knotted black hairstyle under a simple golden sun-crown, saffron angarakha, maroon dhoti, cream uttariya, leather belt and sandals, holding a palm-leaf roll and sheathed khanda, flanked by two modestly dressed cotton-clad sthapatis with headband and topknot or ponytail, one bearing a notched measuring staff and the other a wooden model of the Modhera temple complex, all in saffron, maroon, cream, indigo and off-white tones.

anonymous_maru_gurjara_shilpins.ref_desc: A lean, tanned Maru-Gurjara shilpin in an off-white long-sleeved angarkha, off-white dhoti, reddish-brown waist sash, light-brown shawl, leather sandals, center-parted black hair in a low knot with a headband, copper accents, and a stone mallet and chisel in hand.

naikidevi.ref_desc: Naikidevi is a wheatish-complexioned, early-30s warrior-queen with a long braided black ponytail, thin gold circlet, indigo quilted war-coat over off-white tunic and maroon trousers, saffron sash, pale cream dupatta and a curved steel sword in brown scabbard.

bhima_ii_and_lavanaprasada.ref_desc: Bhima II has an oval medium-brown face, low-knotted black hair under a simple golden turban, a golden-yellow silk angarkha over a deep-red dhoti with cream shawl and a ceremonial straight steel sword, while Lavanaprasada has sharper features, a higher warrior’s knot, a dark-indigo quilted jerkin with steel breastplate over an off-white dhoti, brick-red sash and a practical curved steel talwar, all in golden yellow, deep red, cream, dark indigo and brown leather tones.

vastupal_and_tejpal.ref_desc: Two Porwad Jain brothers: Vastupal with cream angarkha, rust-red sash, off-white shawl with red-gold edge, white churidar, brown sandals, short beard, white turban with red band and rolled architectural parchment; Tejpal with pale green angarkha, green sash and shawl border, white churidar, brown sandals, clean-shaven, white turban with green band and a wooden measuring rod.

nongda_lairen_pakhangba.ref_desc: Nongda Lairen Pakhangba is a lean mid-20s Meitei king with long black hair in a high knot and side-locks, wearing an off-white dhoti, sleeveless upper garment, cream sash and beige shawl with deep-red belt, bronze serpent armband and dark-brown sandals, carrying a straight iron-tipped spear with a red-wrapped grip and bronze serpent motif, in a palette of off-white, deep red, beige, dark brown and pale gold.

king_loiyumba.ref_desc: King Loiyumba is a medium-brown skinned, sharp-featured man in his early 30s with a black topknot and white headband, wearing an off-white dhoti, cream long-sleeved tunic, muted red bordered shawl, simple gold jewellery and sandals, carrying a dark-brown cased palm-leaf manuscript tied with red cord.

meidingu_senbi_kiyamba.ref_desc: Meidingu Senbi Kiyamba is a lean mid-30s Meitei king with an oval light-brown face, almond eyes, black hair in a compact topknot wrapped in a deep-red band, wearing an off-white tunic, deep-indigo sleeveless jacket, white dhoti, diagonal cream sash, simple gold jewellery, and a dark-brown sheathed straight sword at his left hip with accents of maroon and muted gold.

king_senbi_khagemba.ref_desc: King Senbi Khagemba is a late-30s lean Meitei ruler with medium-brown skin, short moustache, black hair in a low knot wrapped with a maroon band, wearing a white pheijom wrap, off-white tunic, cream shawl with deep-red borders, simple torque and leather sandals, and carrying a plain leather-hilted Manipuri sword at his left hip.

king_khagemba_and_keifa_singh.ref_desc: King Khagemba has a medium-brown oval face, black hair in a high topknot with a deep-red headband, a white tunic with indigo vest, cream trousers, red sash and brown riding boots, while Keifa Singh has a white turban, off‑white tunic, light‑brown trousers, olive vest, sandals, and both hold dark-brown Sagol Kangjei sticks with red or white-wrapped grips in a deep red, indigo, off‑white, cream and dark brown palette.

king_pamheiba_gharib_niwaz.ref_desc: King Pamheiba Gharib Niwaz is a wiry, medium-brown, sharp-featured man in his early 40s with a black topknot and white headband, wearing a white dhoti, cream angarkha, saffron scarf, minimal gold jewellery, and carrying a curved steel tulwar in a dark brown scabbard.

king_bhagya_chandra.ref_desc: King Bhagya Chandra is a mid-30s lean Meitei man with oval face, brown complexion, trimmed moustache and beard, black hair in a low topknot with white headband, wearing white tunic, off-white trousers, cream dhoti, pale-gold shawl, red waist belt, simple jewellery and brown sandals, carrying a brown wooden pung drum on a leather strap.

the_meitei_people.ref_desc: Khuman Ngamba is a lean early-twenties Meitei man with a scarred oval face, black topknot with white headband, wearing a white pheijom, off-white tied jacket, diagonal beige shawl with red border, bronze bangle, and a brown-hilted dha sword in a dark wooden back-scabbard.

raja_gambhir_singh.ref_desc: Raja Gambhir Singh is a mid-30s Meitei king with an oval medium-brown face, black hair in a topknot with a white headband, wearing a white jama, deep-red sleeveless overcoat, indigo sash, white dhoti and brown boots, carrying a curved Meitei sword in a dark-brown scabbard with red-wrapped hilt and gold details.

the_women_of_ima_keithel.ref_desc: A late-20s Meitei woman with an oval medium-brown face, straight black hair in a low bun under a thin white headscarf, wearing a maroon striped phanek, off-white innaphi shawl, pale sky-blue blouse and brown sandals, always carrying a bamboo market basket with a petition scroll tied to its handle.

the_meitei_scholars_of_the_script_reviva.figure: The Meitei scholars of the script revival
the_meitei_scholars_of_the_script_reviva.ref_desc: A Meitei male scholar with an oval medium-brown face, black hair in a low bun with a white headband, wearing an off-white long-sleeved tunic, deep indigo striped wrap, light grey shawl with maroon border and brown sandals, holding a palm-leaf manuscript bundle and carved wooden stylus with a folded Meitei-script newspaper.

tikendrajit_singh.ref_desc: Tikendrajit Singh is a late-20s Meitei prince with medium-brown skin, intense dark eyes, black hair in a high knot, wearing a white knee-length tunic, deep-red dhoti, dark-indigo waist-sash, cream shawl, brass armlets, leather sandals, and carrying a brass-hilted sabre in a brown scabbard.

the_fisherfolk_of_loktak.ref_desc: A wiry young Loktak fisher with an oval sun-kissed face, straight black medium-length hair held by a white headband, wearing a sky-blue long-sleeved cotton shirt, off-white striped phanek, maroon sash, olive-green vest and sandals, carrying a bamboo fishing pole and conical bamboo fish trap in muted blue, off-white, maroon, olive-green and brown tones.

chhengthung_fa.ref_desc: Chhengthung Fa is a mid‑30s medium‑brown man with an oval face, neat moustache and goatee, black hair in a high topknot with a red band, wearing an off‑white tunic, rust‑red quilted vest, dark green dhoti, brown leather belt and strap, bronze ornaments, and carrying a curved steel sword in a brown leather scabbard at his left hip.

dharma_manikya_i.ref_desc: Dharma Manikya I is a medium‑brown, oval‑faced king in his early 40s with a black topknot, gold circlet, neat moustache, wearing a deep maroon angarkha over an off‑white dhoti, cream uttariya, dark‑green waist cloth, simple gold jewellery, brown sandals, and carrying a plain‑hilted talwar in a brown scabbard.

ratna_manikya_i.ref_desc: Ratna Manikya I is a wiry mid-30s king with medium-brown oval face, intense dark eyes, black hair in a low knot under a red gold-trimmed turban, wearing a cream anga, red patka, indigo dhoti, green shawl, modest gold jewellery, and a coin-ornamented sword at his left hip in cream, deep red, indigo blue, forest green and muted gold tones.

dhanya_manikya.ref_desc: Dhanya Manikya is a medium-brown, sharp-eyed king in his late 30s with a moustache and short goatee, long black hair in a low bun, a red gold-embroidered headband, white angarkha over indigo quilted coat, red sash, off-white trousers, brown mojari shoes, a slung round shield, and a simple curved talwar in a brown scabbard, all in deep red, white, indigo, brown and gold tones.

vijaya_manikya_ii.ref_desc: Vijaya Manikya II is a medium‑brown, sharp‑eyed man in his early 30s with a black topknot, trimmed moustache and jawline beard, wearing an off‑white tunic under a forest‑green coat with golden trim, maroon waist sash, simple bronze breastplate, churidar trousers, brown sandals, gold ornaments, and carrying a curved Talwar in a brown leather scabbard at his left hip in a maroon‑green‑gold palette.

amar_manikya.ref_desc: Amar Manikya is a medium-built king in his early 40s with a medium-brown oval face, black hair in a low knot under a deep maroon conical turban, wearing an off-white angarkha, olive quilted vest, mustard dhoti, maroon sash, and carrying a curved sword with a dark brown scabbard plus a small silver coin.

the_pilak_artisans.ref_desc: A lean mid-20s Pilak artisan with medium-brown skin, black hair in a low knot with a white headband, wearing an off-white dhoti, light-ochre tunic, reddish-brown shawl and brown sandals, always carrying an iron chisel with stone mallet and a half-finished sandstone Avalokitesvara relief.

n_n_bhattacharyya.ref_desc: N.N. Bhattacharyya is a light‑brown, oval‑faced, bespectacled man in his early fifties with short greying side‑parted black hair, wearing an off‑white kurta, light‑grey trousers, a navy Nehru jacket and brown sandals, always carrying a brown leather notebook with a black‑capped fountain pen.

govinda_manikya.ref_desc: Govinda Manikya is a lean mid‑30s Tripuri king with medium‑brown skin, a thin moustache and short goatee, black hair in a low bun under a maroon gold‑trimmed turban, wearing a cream maroon‑striped jama, maroon patka, indigo churidar, brown mojari shoes, minimal gold jewellery, and carrying a brass‑hilted talwar in a brown leather scabbard.

bir_chandra_manikya.ref_desc: Bir Chandra Manikya is a late-30s brown-complexioned Maharaja with an oval face, neat moustache, short black hair under a white silk turban, wearing a cream angarkha, maroon dhoti, green velvet shawl, brown jutti shoes, and carrying a wooden brass-lensed field camera on a tripod in cream, maroon, green, gold and brown tones.

radha_kishore_manikya.ref_desc: Radha Kishore Manikya is a dignified late-30s Maharaja with an oval medium-brown face, short black hair under a white-gold turban, ivory silk achkan, mint-green dupatta, beige churidar, tan mojari shoes, minimal gold jewellery and a rolled architectural blueprint in hand.

bir_bikram_and_kanchan_prava_devi.display_name: Maharaja Bir Bikram & Regent Kanchan Prava Devi
bir_bikram_and_kanchan_prava_devi.figure: Bir Bikram and Kanchan Prava Devi
bir_bikram_and_kanchan_prava_devi.ref_desc: A tall, athletic Bir Bikram with an oval face, short black hair under a cream turban, cream achkan with maroon accents and churidar, beside graceful Kanchan Prava Devi in a cream-and-maroon Tripuri sari, both holding a red-sealed parchment scroll, all in cream, maroon, green and gold tones.

jadurai.ref_desc: Jadurai is a mid-30s lean Gond chief with a medium-brown complexion, black hair in a back knot with a dark-red headband, wearing a dark-forest-green angarkha, russet-brown sleeveless vest, off-white churidar trousers, dark-ochre shawl, simple brass jewellery, and carrying a long iron-tipped spear with leather-wrapped shaft and red-black cords.

sangram_shah.ref_desc: Sangram Shah is a mid-40s broad-shouldered Gond ruler with medium-brown skin, oval face, black hair in a low knot bound by a deep-red band, wearing an off-white angarkha, forest-green quilted vest, maroon sash, brown trousers, leather sandals, and carrying a simple curved sword with brown scabbard and a rolled palm-leaf manuscript.

dalpat_shah_and_rani_durgavati.ref_desc: Dalpat Shah is a lean, early‑30s ruler with medium-brown complexion, shoulder-length black hair under a dark-red turban, mustard-yellow striped jama, forest-green quilted vest, white churidar and brown mojari, bearing a simple steel talwar, beside Rani Durgavati, a mid‑20s queen with wheat-gold complexion, long braided black hair with gold maang-tikka, deep-maroon ghaghra, saffron-orange odhani, modest gold jewellery and a calm, determined gaze, all in a mustard, maroon, saffron, green and off‑white palette.

rani_durgavati.ref_desc: Rani Durgavati is a wheatish-brown, strong-cheekboned woman in her early 30s with long black hair in a low bun, a slim silver circlet, forest-green lehenga, maroon angarkha coat, off-white dupatta, brown boots, and a simple curved talwar on a brown belt with a small map-roll.

rani_durgavati_and_baz_bahadur.ref_desc: Rani Durgavati has an oval medium-brown face, sharp dark eyes, black braided hair, red angarkha, green quilted armor vest, indigo skirt, mustard dupatta and brown shoes with a brass-hilt tulwar, while Baz Bahadur has a lighter brown face, short beard, green turban, emerald jama, quilted armor coat, off-white churidar and maroon-sheathed tulwar.

vir_narayan_and_the_defenders_of_chaurag.figure: Vir Narayan and the Defenders of Chauragarh
vir_narayan_and_the_defenders_of_chaurag.ref_desc: Vīr Narayan is a wiry, early-twenties prince with medium-brown skin, shoulder-length black hair in a low knot wrapped with a deep-red band, a trimmed beard, wearing an off-white angarkha under a forest-green quilted sleeveless coat, deep-indigo dhoti, tan mojari shoes, copper earrings and bangle, a brown scarf-sash, a round dark-brown shield on his back, and a plain curved talwar in a dark-brown scabbard, all in forest green, deep indigo, off-white, deep red and dark brown tones.

chandra_shah.ref_desc: Chandra Shah is a mid-30s lean hill-warrior with medium-brown complexion, black hair in a low knot under a narrow dark-red turban, wearing a white angarkha, forest-green sleeveless quilted coat, dark-ochre trousers, maroon waist-belt, indigo shawl, and carrying a plain-hilt steel sword in a brown scabbard.

the_gond_clan_chiefs.display_name: Gond Clan Chief of a Garh
the_gond_clan_chiefs.ref_desc: A sturdy mid-30s Gond clan chief with medium-brown complexion, black hair in a short back knot with a red band, forest-green tunic, off-white dhoti, brown quilted coat, ochre shoulder cloth, leather belt and sandals, iron sword at his left and a rolled palm-leaf map bundle in hand.

rani_durgavati_and_adhar_kayastha.ref_desc: Rani Durgavati is a medium‑brown, sharp‑eyed queen with a low black braid, indigo sari with red‑mustard border, modest gold jewellery and a leather‑belted talwar at her hip, while Adhar Kayastha is darker, moustached, in off‑white angarkha, pagri, grey dhoti, with map bundle and notched wooden staff, all in deep indigo, brick red, mustard yellow, off‑white and dark brown tones.

the_pardhan_bards.ref_desc: A medium-brown, oval-faced Pardhan bard with black hair in a low knot and a cloth headband, wearing an off-white embroidered tunic, indigo dhoti, off-white shawl, simple beads and bangle, carrying a light-brown bamboo kingri with dark wood bow and muted red pouch.

sangram_shah_and_bhanudatta_misra.ref_desc: Sangram Shah is a deep-brown, strong-jawed king with a maroon-bordered cream kurta, forest-green dhoti, dark red turban and sheathed sword plus palm-leaf manuscript, beside wheat-brown scholar Bhanudatta Miśra in off-white dhoti, beige angarakha, pale-yellow shawl and open palm-leaf manuscript.

hridayshah.ref_desc: Hridayshah is a lean, medium-brown man in his late 30s with a low hair knot, maroon Deccan-style turban, off-white angarkha, olive quilted sleeveless coat, maroon sash, mustard churidar, brown mojari shoes, gold accents, a brass-hilt talwar at his left and a small manuscript roll at his right.

shankar_shah_and_raghunath_shah.ref_desc: Shankar Shah is an older, lean man in an off-white angarkha, saffron shawl, white churidar and white turban beside his son Raghunath Shah, a younger athletic man in a cream angarkha, indigo waistcoat, dark-red sash, white turban and brown shoes, together holding a single brown-sheathed talwar.

prabhakaravardhana.ref_desc: Prabhakaravardhana is a medium‑tall, early‑40s north Indian king with an oval medium‑brown face, moustache and short beard, black hair in a low top‑knot held by a gold circlet, wearing a deep‑red angarkha, cream patterned vest, off‑white dhoti, indigo waist sash, beige shawl, simple gold jewellery, and carrying a plain‑hilted straight iron sword in a dark scabbard.

rajyashri.ref_desc: Rajyashri is a late-20s, warm-brown–skinned princess with an oval face, large brown eyes, long black hair in a high bun under a gold lotus circlet, wearing a saffron-ochre sari with cream blouse and shawl, simple gold jewellery, and carrying a dark-wood palm-leaf Buddhist manuscript tied with maroon cord in saffron, maroon, cream and gold tones.

bhaskaravarman.ref_desc: Bhaskaravarman is a lean, medium-brown young king with an oval face, long black hair in a high topknot under a simple gold circlet, wearing a white tunic, saffron-yellow silk uttariya, off-white dhoti with maroon borders, gold ornaments, brown sandals, and carrying a red-tied sachi-bark manuscript bundle.

harsha.ref_desc: Harsha is a tall, lean man of about 30–35 with a wheatish complexion, wavy black hair in a high topknot wrapped by a narrow gold headband, wearing an off‑white angarkha, golden‑yellow striped dhoti, deep‑green shawl, maroon belt, simple gold ornaments, brown sandals, and a plain curved sword at his left hip.

banabhatta.ref_desc: Bāṇabhaṭṭa is a lean thirtyish North Indian man with medium‑brown skin, large thoughtful eyes, black hair in a low topknot with a white headband, wearing an off‑white cotton uttarīya and ankle‑length dhoti edged in pale saffron, simple beads and sandals, and carrying a palm‑leaf manuscript bundle with a reed pen and brown manuscript pouch strap across his fully covered chest.

banabhatta_and_bhushanabhatta.ref_desc: Bāṇa and Bhūṣaṇabhaṭṭa are a lean, medium‑brown father and son with black hair in knots, Bāṇa mustached with a cream headband in off‑white dhoti, cream kurta and saffron shawl, Bhūṣaṇa clean‑shaven in grey dhoti, pale blue kurta and white‑blue shawl, jointly carrying a bound palm‑leaf manuscript bundle with reed pen in warm off‑white, saffron, pale blue, maroon and brown tones.

xuanzang.ref_desc: Xuanzang is a slim early-30s Tang monk with a light-olive oval face, shaved tonsure with a dark-brown headband, wearing a light-beige inner robe, saffron-ochre kashaya, gray-blue travel cloak, dark-brown boots and strap, dark-red satchel, and carrying a plain khakkhara staff plus a dark-yellow-wrapped manuscript bundle.

wang_xuance.ref_desc: Wang Xuance is a mid-30s lean Tang envoy-general with an oval light-tan face, narrow intense eyes, black hair in a high topknot under a small dark-green cap, wearing deep-red and cream robes under dark-brown lamellar armour with dark-blue trousers and brown boots, carrying a dark-red scabbarded Tang dao at his left hip.

harsha_s_sources.ref_desc: Harsha’s Sources is a slim early-twenties scholar with wheat-brown oval face, round spectacles, black hair in a low knot and off-white angarkha, grey wrap, indigo shawl and bundled scrolls and copper plate under one arm with reed pen behind the ear.

siyaka_ii.ref_desc: Siyaka II is a mid-30s, lean brown-complexioned man with an oval face, neat moustache and short beard, black hair in a high warrior’s knot under a narrow gold circlet, wearing an off-white angarakha, maroon reinforced vest, beige dhoti, olive shawl, indigo-and-maroon sash, leather boots, minimal gold jewellery, and carrying a double-edged straight sword in a dark brown scabbard.

vakpati_munja.ref_desc: Vakpati II Munja is a mid-30s, medium-brown, oval-faced king with a short beard, black hair in a topknot under a gold circlet, wearing a deep green angarakha, maroon quilted vest, off‑white dhoti, mustard sash and indigo shawl, carrying a straight sword and palm‑leaf manuscript bundle.

bhoja_of_dhara.ref_desc: Bhoja of Dhara is a mid-30s wheatish warrior-king with a black topknot under a gold circlet and maroon headband, wearing an off-white angarakha, maroon uttariya, indigo dhoti, olive-brown quilted jerkin, bronze bracers, and a leather-belted early Indian sword in a dark brown scabbard.

bhoja_of_dhara_and_the_bhojpur_masons.figure: Bhoja of Dhara and the Bhojpur masons
bhoja_of_dhara_and_the_bhojpur_masons.ref_desc: Bhoja of Dhara is a lean, wheatish-brown king in his late 30s with an oval face, black topknot hair and gold headband, wearing a deep maroon angarakha, ochre-yellow vest, cream sash and off-white dhoti, modest gold jewellery, brown sandals, and carrying a rolled palm-leaf manuscript plus a wooden measuring staff with plumb-bob in a palette of maroon, ochre, cream, off-white, brown and gold.

bhoja_and_the_paramara_administrators.ref_desc: Bhoja of Dhara is a mid-30s medium-brown Paramara king with an oval face, neat moustache, black hair in a low bun with a maroon band and gold circlet, wearing an ivory angarakha, maroon silk uttariya, off-white ankle dhoti, simple gold jewellery, and holding a rolled copper-plate charter sealed with a round copper seal, in maroon, ivory, warm brown, gold, and off-white tones.

bhoja_and_the_scholars_of_dhar.figure: Bhoja and the scholars of Dhar
bhoja_and_the_scholars_of_dhar.ref_desc: Bhoja of Dhara is a mid-40s Malwa scholar-king with an oval medium-brown face, neat moustache and beard, black hair in a topknot with gold circlet, wearing a deep maroon angarakha, cream uttariya, off-white dhoti, simple gold jewellery, and holding a palm-leaf manuscript bundle with stylus.

dhanapala.ref_desc: Dhanapala is a late‑30s Jain scholar with an oval wheatish face, short beard, back‑tied dark hair under an off‑white headband, wearing an off‑white angarkha, cream dhoti with maroon border, saffron‑beige shawl, indigo manuscript satchel, and holding a bound palm‑leaf manuscript bundle.

udayaditya.ref_desc: Udayaditya is a medium-tall, early-40s Malwa king with a medium-brown oval face, black hair in a high knot with a thin gold circlet, wearing a deep maroon angarakha, off-white dhoti, cream uttariya, gold jewellery, brown sandals, and holding a red-tied rolled copperplate charter.

mahalakadeva_and_goga.ref_desc: Mahalakadeva is a lean, medium-brown man with an oval face, short beard, shoulder-length dark hair under a muted gold turban, wearing an off-white patterned angarkha, red shawl and churidar with a sheathed straight sword, beside broader, darker Goga in an indigo quilted coat, red turban, olive trousers, boots, and carrying a curved talwar and round iron shield, all in off-white, deep red, indigo, olive and brown tones.

bhillama_v.ref_desc: Bhillama V appears as a mid-30s Deccan warrior-king with an oval brown face, short knot of black hair, cream tunic under indigo vest, ochre dhoti, deep-red sash, simple gold ornaments, steel sword at the hip and a rolled fort-map, in cream, indigo, red, ochre, brown and gold tones.

singhana_ii.ref_desc: Singhana II is a wheatish-brown, strong-jawed Yadava king with black topknot and gold circlet, wearing a deep-red patterned jama, cream churidar, saffron shawl, dark green belt, bronze arm-guards and shoes, and bearing a bronze-hilted sword with dark brown scabbard.
